situation_name: CICSplex_AIDs_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for AIDs
actions: {"If many AIDs have accumulated, response time may be adversely affected because CICS attempts to start each AID on every dispatch of the Terminal Control Program.If a required terminal is unavailable because a task currently running on the terminal is not completing, you may kill the task with OMEGAMON/CICS and allow the scheduled AID to execute.If the AID is waiting on a remote system, check that the remote system is available and that the connections are in service."}

situation_name: CICSplex_AIDs_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for AIDs
actions: {"If many AIDs have accumulated, response time may be adversely affected because CICS attempts to start each AID on every dispatch of the Terminal Control Program.If a required terminal is unavailable because a task currently running on the terminal is not completing, you may kill the task with OMEGAMON/CICS and allow the scheduled AID to execute.If the AID is waiting on a remote system, check that the remote system is available and that the connections are in service."}

situation_name: CICSplex_Activity_Warning
description: BTS Activity has Abended or has been Forced
actions: {"The Business Transaction Services Activity identified in the alert is in an ABENDED or FORCED state - which means that it has not completed normally. You should consider checking the applications that are associated with this Activity to ensure that the data it processes is in a valid state."}

situation_name: CICSplex_AtClassMax_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for Class Max Task limit
actions: {"When the limit is reached for a class, a new task belonging to the same class cannot be run until an old task has terminated.Use the Transaction Analysis report to determine whether a problem is preventing tasks within the specified class from completing in a timely manner.For example, tasks may be waiting for an enqueue, or CICS itself may be short-on-storage.If you find that the class max task value is too low, you may change it with either OMEGAMON/CICS or the CICS CEMT transaction."}

situation_name: CICSplex_AtClassMax_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for Class Max Task limit
actions: {"When the limit is reached for a class, a new task belonging to the same class cannot be run until an old task has terminated.Use the Transaction Analysis report to determine whether a problem is preventing tasks within the specified class from completing in a timely manner.For example, tasks may be waiting for an enqueue, or CICS itself may be short-on-storage.If you find that the class max task value is too low, you may change it with either OMEGAMON/CICS or the CICS CEMT transaction."}

situation_name: CICSplex_AtMaxTCB_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded TCBs for currently attached
actions: {"The number of TCBs currently attached is either equal to or greater than the maximum number of TCBs allowed for the pool that is being reported on . Review the CICS System Initialization Table parameters MAXJVMTCBS, MAXOPEN TCBS, MAXSSLTCBS or MAXXPTCBS and increase the maximum that can be allocated alternatively you can change the values dynamically by using the CEMT SET DISPATCHER command."}

situation_name: CICSplex_AtMaxTask_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for Max Task limit
actions: {"When CICS is at the MXT limit, no new tasks will be dispatched.Use the Transaction Analysis report to determine whether there is a problem that is preventing tasks from completing in a timely manner.For example, tasks may be waiting for an enqueue, or CICS may be short-on-storage.To alleviate a bottleneck, you may use OMEGAMON/CICS to kill the tasks causing degradation.The initial MXT limit is defined in the SIT and may be changed dynamically using the CEMT transaction."}

situation_name: CICSplex_AtMaxTask_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for Max Task limit
actions: {"When CICS is at the MXT limit, no new tasks will be dispatched.Use the Transaction Analysis report to determine whether there is a problem that is preventing tasks from completing in a timely manner.For example, tasks may be waiting for an enqueue, or CICS may be short-on-storage.To alleviate a bottleneck, you may use OMEGAMON/CICS to kill the tasks causing degradation.The initial MXT limit is defined in the SIT and may be changed dynamically using the CEMT transaction."}

situation_name: CICSplex_Atom_Feed_Warning
description: Atom Feed is Disabled.
actions: {"The selected Atom Feed is disabled. You should review the CICS log for messages related to this Atom Feed to determine the cause of this problem. You can discard the existing definition, and reinstall the Atom Feed. Be sure to check for messages that are issued during this process. You can use the take action feature of OMEGAMON XE for CICS on z/OS to issue a command to enable the Atom Feed."}

situation_name: CICSplex_Bundle_Parts_Warning
description: Application Bundle Part is not Enabled.
actions: {"The selected Application Bundle Part is not enabled. You should review the CICS log for messages relating to the named Application Bundle Part. You can also use the take action feature of OMEGAMON XE for CICS on z/OS to enable the Application Bundle Part. If the installed definition is incorrect you can discard the definition, and reinstall the correct definition using CEDA."}

situation_name: CICSplex_Bundle_Warning
description: Application Bundle is not Enabled.
actions: {"The selected Application Bundle is not enabled. You should review the CICS log for messages relating to the named Application Bundle. You can also use the take action feature of OMEGAMON XE for CICS on z/OS to enable the Application Bundle. If the installed definition is incorrect you can discard the definition, and reinstall the correct definition using CEDA."}

situation_name: CICSplex_CICSCPUHigh_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for CICS high CPU usage
actions: {"CICS may be using more CPU than normal.Additional diagnostics can be obtained by generating a Region Overview report and checking whether the CICS time-of-day clock is being updated.The Transaction Analysis report may be used to locate looping tasks, or those that have exceeded their Global CPU usage limit (MAXR)."}

situation_name: CICSplex_CICSCPUHigh_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for CICS high CPU usage
actions: {"CICS may be using more CPU than normal.Additional diagnostics can be obtained by generating a Region Overview report and checking whether the CICS time-of-day clock is being updated.The Transaction Analysis report may be used to locate looping tasks, or those that have exceeded their Global CPU usage limit (MAXR)."}

situation_name: CICSplex_CICSCPULow_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for CICS low CPU usage
actions: {"CICS may be requiring fewer CPU cycles than normal for the expected transaction rate.If response time is unacceptable, check the transaction rate display in the Region Overview report to see if the rate is lower than normal.Next, see if Transaction Analysis is showing active task activity, and if so, use the Impact Analysis function of OMEGAMON/CICS to determine why CICS is not being dispatched.If there is no contention, check the network to see if terminals are active."}

situation_name: CICSplex_CICSCPULow_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for CICS low CPU usage
actions: {"CICS may be requiring fewer CPU cycles than normal for the expected transaction rate.If response time is unacceptable, check the transaction rate display in the Region Overview report to see if the rate is lower than normal.Next, see if Transaction Analysis is showing active task activity, and if so, use the Impact Analysis function of OMEGAMON/CICS to determine why CICS is not being dispatched.If there is no contention, check the network to see if terminals are active."}

situation_name: CICSplex_CSMI_delay_in_FCP
description: Service Level failure (CSMI) with excessive time in File Control
actions: {"Use the historical transaction display function of OMEGAMON/CICS to locate the mirror transactions that are responsible for the service level failure.Determine whether the large amount of time waiting on File Control is a consequence of either application changes or alterations in the CICS file configuration.If the transaction behavior is found to be normal, consider updating the service class definitions so that they will accurately reflect anticipated response times."}

situation_name: CICSplex_ClassMax_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for Class Max Task
actions: {"Generally, the recommendation to put transactions in a transaction class is required by the application to restrict access to resources in CICS.If response time is not acceptable, it may be necessary to re-evaluate why the task has been placed in a transaction class.If you determine that the class max task value is too low, you may change it with either OMEGAMON/CICS or the CICS CEMT transaction."}

situation_name: CICSplex_ClassMax_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for Class Max Task
actions: {"Generally, the recommendation to put transactions in a transaction class is required by the application to restrict access to resources in CICS.If response time is not acceptable, it may be necessary to re-evaluate why the task has been placed in a transaction class.If you determine that the class max task value is too low, you may change it with either OMEGAMON/CICS or the CICS CEMT transaction."}

situation_name: CICSplex_Corbaserver_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded Corbaserver not enabled
actions: {"The Corbaserver identified in the alert is not enabled. Determine why the Corbaserver is not enabled and take the appropriate action."}

situation_name: CICSplex_DB2Abort_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for DB2 abort percent
actions: {"Consider changing the THREADWAIT parameter of the DB2ENTRY definition for this transaction.YES allows a task to be queued when no threads are available; POOL allows a task to use a pool thread.Increase the THREADLIMIT of the DB2ENTRY definition for the transaction, or use the MODIFY option of the DSNC transaction to increase it dynamically.Increasing the number of threads will increase the overhead of the MVS dispatcher scanning the TCB chain."}

situation_name: CICSplex_DB2Abort_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for DB2 abort percent
actions: {"Consider changing the THREADWAIT parameter of the DB2ENTRY definition for this transaction.YES allows a task to be queued when no threads are available; POOL allows a task to use a pool thread.Increase the THREADLIMIT of the DB2ENTRY definition for the transaction, or use the MODIFY option of the DSNC transaction to increase it dynamically.Increasing the number of threads will increase the overhead of the MVS dispatcher scanning the TCB chain."}

situation_name: CICSplex_DB2Attached_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for DB2 attach status
actions: {"Verify that DB2 is required for this CICS region.If DB2 is needed, attach DB2 for this region using DSNC STRT.Include the DB2 startup program in the CICS startup PLT or specify DB2CONN=YES in the SIT."}

situation_name: CICSplex_DB2Attached_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for DB2 attach status
actions: {"Verify that DB2 is required for this CICS region.If DB2 is needed, attach DB2 for this region using DSNC STRT.Include the DB2 startup program in the CICS startup PLT or specify DB2CONN=YES in the SIT."}

situation_name: CICSplex_DB2MaxThreads_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for DB2 maximum threads
actions: {"It is not detrimental to reach a high percentage of the maximum active thread limit.However, when the ratio frequently nears 100%, you should increase the value specified in the THREADLIMIT parameter for the transaction.You may also increase it dynamically using the MODIFY TRANSACTION option of the DSNC transaction.Increasing the number of threads increases the overhead of the MVS dispatcher scanning the TCB chain."}

situation_name: CICSplex_DB2MaxThreads_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for DB2 maximum threads
actions: {"It is not detrimental to reach a high percentage of the maximum active thread limit.However, when the ratio frequently nears 100%, you should increase the value specified in the THREADLIMIT parameter for the transaction.You may also increase it dynamically using the MODIFY TRANSACTION option of the DSNC transaction.Increasing the number of threads increases the overhead of the MVS dispatcher scanning the TCB chain."}

situation_name: CICSplex_DB2ThreadHWM_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for DB2 thread HWM
actions: {"If the problem is intermittent, you may increase the maximum number of active tasks for this transaction temporarily with the MODIFY option of the DSNC transaction.If the threshold is exceeded frequently, consider raising the maximum number of active threads by changing the THREADLIMIT parameter in the DB2ENTRY definition.Increasing the number of threads, however, increases the overhead of the MVS dispatcher scanning the TCB chain."}

situation_name: CICSplex_DB2ThreadUse_Critical

situation_name: CICSplex_DB2ThreadUse_Warning

situation_name: CICSplex_DB2Wait_Critical

situation_name: CICSplex_DJAR_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded DJar not usable or resolved
actions: {"The Deployed JAR identified in the alert is in an UNRESOLVED or UNUSABLE state. Determine why the DJAR is in this state and take the appropriate action. Verify that the DJAR is present in the directory specified in the HFS file parameter and that it has been correctly built. Use theoutput from the DJAR resolution process in the CICS job log for full d etails of the error."}

situation_name: CICSplex_DJAR_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded Deployed JAR being discarded
actions: {"The Deployed JAR identified in the alert is being discarded. Determine why the DJAR is being discarded and take the appropriate action."}

situation_name: CICSplex_DSAAvail_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for low DSA availability
actions: {"Ensure that the predicates in this situation are set to trip only when available storage before SOS is critically small.DSA extents are allocated in units of 256KB.The exception to this is the user DSA which is 1MB when storage isolation is active.Change the DSALIM parameter for the CICS address space to increase the storage available to CICS."}

situation_name: CICSplex_DSAAvail_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for low DSA availability
actions: {"Ensure that the predicates in this situation are set to trip only when available storage before SOS is critically small.DSA extents are allocated in units of 256KB.The exception to this is the user DSA which is 1MB when storage isolation is active.Change the DSALIM parameter for the CICS address space to increase the storage available to CICS."}

situation_name: CICSplex_DSAHigh_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for high DSA usage
actions: {"Consider increasing the size of the CICS region and make the DSA larger.Increase the region size only if the Region Overview report shows adequate LSQA to support the change.It is also worth checking the current OSCOR utilization.If the DSA size cannot be increased, consider reducing the CICS MXT value."}

situation_name: CICSplex_DSAHigh_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for high DSA usage

situation_name: CICSplex_DSALow_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for low DSA usage
actions: {"If this situation fires consistently, it may indicate an excessive DSA size.Decrease the size of the DSA for the CICS region.If there are very few tasks, there could be very little DSA in use.Consider increasing the maximum number of tasks (MXT) CICS may process at one time."}

situation_name: CICSplex_DSALow_Warning

situation_name: CICSplex_DSASOS_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for DSA short-on-storage
actions: {"Use the storage displays of OMEGAMON/CICS to locate tasks that are using a large amount of DSA.Verify that their storage requests are for a reasonable amount of memory.To determine if a given task is hung in a storage control request, go to the Transaction Analysis report and look at the Wait Type field.Consider using the CICS CEMT transaction or the KILL option of OMEGAMON/CICS to purge the offending task."}

situation_name: CICSplex_EDSAAvail_Critical

description: Critical threshold exceeded for high EDSA usage
actions: {"Increase EDSALIM in the CICS System Initialization Table.The Storage Analysis report will provide an overview of storage availability within each constituent EDSA.For task and CICS component storage usage, consult the storage displays offered by OMEGAMON/CICS."}

situation_name: CICSplex_EDSALow_Critical

situation_name: CICSplex_ENQWaitCount_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for enqueue task waits
actions: {"Select the Enqueue Analysis report to find all tasks waiting on enqueues and the owners of the serially reusable resources.If an enqueue is not being released, examine the owning task's resource type to determine whether it is looping, waiting on a resource, or deadlocked with another task.You may use the KILL command of OMEGAMON/CICS to free the enqueue and allow the waiting tasks to continue.To limit the number of tasks suspended due to enqueue conflicts, consider transaction classes."}

situation_name: CICSplex_ENQWaitCount_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for enqueue task waits
actions: {"Select the Enqueue Analysis report to find all tasks waiting on enqueues and the owners of the serially reusable resources.If an enqueue is not being released, examine the owning task's resource type to determine whether it is looping, waiting on a resource, or deadlocked with another task.You may use the KILL command of OMEGAMON/CICS to free the enqueue and allow the waiting tasks to continue.To limit the number of tasks suspended due to enqueue conflicts, consider transaction classes."}

situation_name: CICSplex_Event_Proc_Warning
description: Event Processing is Stopped.
actions: {"Event Processing is disabled. You can use the take action feature of OMEGAMON XE for CICS on z/OS to enable Event Processing. You should also check the CICS log for messages related to Event Processing."}

situation_name: CICSplex_ExitConn_Warning
description: Exit Program not connected
actions: {"The Exit Program associated with this alert is showing a Connection Status other than CONNECTED. Check the Connection Status of your Exit Program to determine what is wrong. In need, refer to the CICSSystems Programmers Reference Manual for guidance."}

situation_name: CICSplex_ExitStart_Warning
description: Exit Program is stopped
actions: {"The Exit Program associated with this alert is showing a Start Status other than STARTED. A STOPPED Status means that the Exit Program is not available for execution; that is, the START option on an EXEC CICS ENABLE command has not been issued, or has been revoked by the STOP option on an EXEC CICS DISABLE command. Issue an EXEC CICS ENABLE command to start your Exit Program."}

situation_name: CICSplex_Func_Ship_delay_CPU
description: Service Level failure (CSM*) in any function shipping request
actions: {"Use the historical transaction display function of OMEGAMON XE for CICS on z/OS to locate the mirror transactions that are responsible for the service level failure, the Bottleneck Analysis workspace can further assist in locating the wait reasons responsible for slow response time. Consider increasing the priority of the region to prevent File Owning Regions from adversely affecting Application Owning Regions that use function shipping."}

situation_name: CICSplex_Func_Ship_delay_DLI
description: Service Level failure (CSM*) in any function shipping request
actions: {"Use the historical transaction display function of OMEGAMON XE for CICS on z/OS to locate the mirror transactions that are responsible for the service level failure, the Bottleneck Analysis workspace can further assist in locating the wait reasons responsible for slow response time. An issue with high waits on DLI indicates a potential problem with IMS subsystems connected to this CICS region. Use OMEGAMON XE for IMS to check the condition of connected IMS subsystems."}

situation_name: CICSplex_Func_Ship_delay_JNL
description: Service Level failure (CSM*) in any function shipping request
actions: {"Use the historical transaction display function of OMEGAMON XE for CICS on z/OS to locate the mirror transactions that are responsible for the service level failure, the Bottleneck Analysis workspace can further assist in locating the wait reasons responsible for slow response time. Ensure the defined journals have sufficient capacity for this workload and use the Transaction Analysis workspace to check the number of task attempting to use the same journal."}

situation_name: CICSplex_Func_Ship_delay_RDIS
description: Service Level failure (CSM*) in any function shipping request
actions: {"Use the historical transaction display function of OMEGAMON XE for CICS on z/OS to locate the mirror transactions that are responsible for the service level failure, the Bottleneck Analysis workspace can further assist in locating the wait reasons responsible for slow response time. If CPU limitations are found to be the root cause, consider increasing the priority of the region to prevent File Owning Regions from adversely affecting Application Owning Regions that use function shipping. Check the maximum task setting for this CICS region and consider increasing if the situation persists."}

situation_name: CICSplex_Func_Ship_delay_TS
description: Service Level failure (CSM*) in any function shipping request
actions: {"Use the historical transaction display function of OMEGAMON XE for CICS on z/OS to locate the mirror transactions that are responsible for the service level failure, the Bottleneck Analysis workspace can further assist in locating the wait reasons responsible for slow response time. Use the Temporary Storage Queues and Temporary Storage Summary workspaces to identify any queues that are being used excessively by tasks."}

situation_name: CICSplex_Function_Ship_delays
description: Service Level failure (CSM*) in any function shipping request
actions: {"Use the historical transaction display function of OMEGAMON/CICS to locate the mirror transactions that are responsible for the service level failure.The Bottleneck Analysis report may further assist in locating the wait reasons responsible for slow response time.If CPU limitations are found to be the root cause, consider increasing the priority of the region to prevent File Owning Regions from adversely affecting Application Owning Regions that use function shipping."}

situation_name: CICSplex_Held_RLS_Locks
description: Detect Held locks
actions: {"Select the RLS Lock Analysis report to find any tasks that may be waiting for an RLS lock to become available.If a lock is not being released, use the Transaction Analysis report to display the owning task's wait type to determine whether it is looping, waiting on a resource, or deadlocked with another task.You may use the KILL command of OMEGAMON/CICS to free the lock and allow waiting tasks to continue.To limit the number of lock conflicts, consider transaction classes."}

situation_name: CICSplex_HostStatus_Warning
description: Virtual Host definition is disabled
actions: {"The Virtual Host associated with this alert is showing a status other than ENABLED. A disabled status means that the URIMAP definitions which make up the Virtual Host cannot be accessed by applications. Check your Virtual Host definitions to ensure that the Virtual Host is enabled, and enable it or redefine your URIMAP if necessary."}

situation_name: CICSplex_ICEs_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for ICEs
actions: {"An excessive number of ICEs for the same transaction ID may indicate that the issuing task is looping.When ICEs are scheduled for a task which you do not wish to run or are associated with a terminal that is not available, OMEGAMON/CICS allows you to view and kill these ICEs.Check whether the expiry time and date for the ICE has passed.If so, CICS may be in a stress situation such as short-on-storage or at the maximum task limit.Remedying that problem allows the ICEs to be processed."}

situation_name: CICSplex_ICEs_Warning

situation_name: CICSplex_IORateHigh_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for high CICS I/O rate
actions: {"Use the CDEV command in OMEGAMON/CICS to determine whether a particular volume is causing the high I/O rate.Bottleneck Analysis, VSAM displays, and current and historical transaction displays in OMEGAMON/CICS may all be used to decide if there is contention for a particular file, as well as identifying the transaction responsible for the I/O activity."}

situation_name: CICSplex_IORateHigh_Warning

situation_name: CICSplex_JVMClasscache_Warning

This value can be changed dynamically by using the CEMT Perform Classcache command. See the CICS Performance Guide for full instructions on how to calculate the optimum class cache size."}

situation_name: CICSplex_JVMProgram_Warning

If the installed definition is incorrect you can discard the definition, and reinstall the correct definition using CEDA."}

situation_name: CICSplex_JournalDis_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for disabled journal

situation_name: CICSplex_MaxTask_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for Max Task percent
actions: {"When CICS is at the MXT limit, no new tasks will be dispatched.Use the Transaction Analysis report to determine whether there is a problem that is preventing tasks from completing in a timely manner.For example, tasks may be waiting for an enqueue, or CICS may be short-on-storage.To alleviate a bottleneck, you may use OMEGAMON/CICS to kill the tasks causing degradation.The initial MXT limit is defined in the SIT and may be changed dynamically using the CEMT transaction."}

situation_name: CICSplex_OSCORLow_Critical

actions: {"Shortages of OSCOR will cause S80A abends.Also, CICS applications should not be executing functions that result in bypassing CICS to make operating system calls.Review the region size of CICS, and consider reducing the size of the DSA to ensure enough OSCOR is available for MVS system functions."}

situation_name: CICSplex_PageRate_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for CICS paging rate
actions: {"A page-in can cause the CICS job to wait for the page fault to resolve.Any delay during this process, regardless of the cause, degrades response time for all CICS tasks.Use the Region Overview report to view the CICS page-in rate and working set size.Consider the use of storage isolation.For multiple CICS regions, use the LPA option for CICS nucleus modules."}

situation_name: CICSplex_PageRate_Warning

situation_name: CICSplex_PagepoolSOS_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for Pagepool details
actions: {"The reported pagepool has experienced more than one Short On Storagecondition. Use the storage displays of OMEGAMON/CICS to locate tasks that are using a large amount of DSA.Verify that their storage requests are for a reasonable amount of memory.To determine if a given task is hung in a storage control request, go to the Transaction Analysis report and look at the Wait Type field.Consider using the CICS CEMT transaction or the KILL option of OMEGAMON/CICS to purge the offending task."}

situation_name: CICSplex_Performance_Index
description: Service Level failure
actions: {"Use the historical transaction display function of OMEGAMON/CICS to locate the transactions that are responsible for the service level failure.The breakdown of time statistics in the historical transaction detail may identify the component that is causing the response time to be excessive.If the transaction behavior is found to be normal, consider updating the service class definitions so that they will accurately reflect anticipated response times."}

situation_name: CICSplex_ProcessType_Warning
description: ProcessType is not Enabled
actions: {"The ProcessType in the alert is not enabled. Business Transaction Services will not allow new Processes of this type to be defined until its state is reset to enabled."}

situation_name: CICSplex_RTAGroup_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for group response time
actions: {"Use the historical transaction display function of OMEGAMON/CICS to locate the transactions that have caused an RTA threshold to be exceeded.The Bottleneck Analysis report may further assist in locating the wait reasons responsible for slow response times.If CPU bound transactions are unable to get the processor resources they need, consider increasing the priority of either the transaction or the CICS region."}

situation_name: CICSplex_RecMgr_Warning
description: Current Shunted UOW Count is greater than 10
actions: {"The CICS Recovery Manager is reporting that there are currently more than 10 instances of Units-of-work shunted for Indoubt. This indicates that the CICS region performance is going to start degrading unless some remedial action is taken relating to the reason for the shunted Units-of-work. Use the Unit-of-work queries available within the OMEGAMON XE for CICS client to verify whether the cause for failing transactions is related, and taken action to restore system and application integrity."}

situation_name: CICSplex_ShuntedUOWs_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for shunted UOWs
actions: {"If shunted UOWs are causing problems, such as holding locks that result in enqueue failures, you should consider forcing a decision.The UOW Enqueue Analysis report will provide a list of all UOW IDs, including those that are shunted.Using either OMEGAMON/CICS or the CICS CEMT transaction, you may perform the following actions against a shunted UOW:force backout, force commit, or force defined action."}

situation_name: CICSplex_ShuntedUOWs_Warning

situation_name: CICSplex_Sympathy_Degradation

situation_name: CICSplex_Sympathy_Sickness

situation_name: CICSplex_TakingSDUMP_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for taking system dump
actions: {"Inspect the operator's console for error messages which may indicate the cause of the problem.Format the contents of the dump dataset to diagnose the CICS abnormal termination."}

situation_name: CICSplex_TakingSDUMP_Warning

actions: {"Inspect the operator's console for error messages which may indicate the cause of the problem.Format the contents of the dump dataset to diagnose the CICS abnormal termination."}

situation_name: CICSplex_TotENQWaits_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for CICS enqueue waits
actions: {"Select the Enqueue Analysis report to find all tasks waiting on enqueues and the owners of the serially reusable resources.If an enqueue is not being released, examine the owning task's resource type to determine whether it is looping, waiting on a resource, or deadlocked with another task.You may use the KILL command of OMEGAMON/CICS to free the enqueue and allow the waiting tasks to continue.To limit the number of tasks suspended due to enqueue conflicts, consider transaction classes."}

situation_name: CICSplex_TotENQWaits_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for CICS enqueue waits
actions: {"Select the Enqueue Analysis report to find all tasks waiting on enqueues and the owners of the serially reusable resources.If an enqueue is not being released, examine the owning task's resource type to determine whether it is looping, waiting on a resource, or deadlocked with another task.You may use the KILL command of OMEGAMON/CICS to free the enqueue and allow the waiting tasks to continue.To limit the number of tasks suspended due to enqueue conflicts, consider transaction classes."}

situation_name: CICSplex_TranCPUTime_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for transaction CPU time
actions: {"A CICS transaction may be using more CPU than normal.If the Transaction Analysis report indicates that the processor time associated with a transaction is rising rapidly, the task may be in a loop.Looping transactions may be terminated automatically using the Resource Limiting function of OMEMGAMON/CICS or manually via the KILL command."}

situation_name: CICSplex_TranRateHigh_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for high transaction rate
actions: {"If the total transaction rate is high and the rate for transactions completing is low, check the navigation tree for situations that may identify other problems preventing tasks from completing."}

situation_name: CICSplex_TranRateLow_Critical

actions: {"If the total transaction rate is low, check the navigation tree for situations that may identify other problems preventing tasks from being attached.For example, CICS may be short-on-storage or in a stall condition."}

situation_name: CICSplex_TranRateLow_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for low transaction rate
actions: {"If the total transaction rate is low, check the navigation tree for situations that may identify other problems preventing tasks from being attached.For example, CICS may be short-on-storage or in a stall condition."}

situation_name: CICSplex_UOWENQFail_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for UOW enqueue failures
actions: {"If shunted UOWs are causing problems, such as holding locks that result in enqueue failures, you should consider forcing a decision.The UOW Enqueue Analysis report will provide a list of all UOW IDs, including those that are shunted.Using either OMEGAMON/CICS or the CICS CEMT transaction, you may perform the following actions against a shunted UOW:force backout, force commit, or force defined action."}

situation_name: CICSplex_UOWENQFail_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for UOW enqueue failures
actions: {"If shunted UOWs are causing problems, such as holding locks that result in enqueue failures, you should consider forcing a decision.The UOW Enqueue Analysis report will provide a list of all UOW IDs, including those that are shunted.Using either OMEGAMON/CICS or the CICS CEMT transaction, you may perform the following actions against a shunted UOW:force backout, force commit, or force defined action."}

situation_name: CICSplex_UOWForce_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for UOW forced decisions
actions: {"A forced decision may occur after an indoubt UOW remains unresolved for a user-defined time period.CICS will unconditionally backout or commit the changes made by the UOW in order to release the resources held by the indoubt UOW."}

situation_name: CICSplex_UOWForce_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for UOW forced decisions
actions: {"A forced decision may occur after an indoubt UOW remains unresolved for a user-defined time period.CICS will unconditionally backout or commit the changes made by the UOW in order to release the resources held by the indoubt UOW."}

situation_name: CICSplex_UOWShuntTime_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for total shunt time
actions: {"If shunted UOWs are causing problems, such as holding locks that result in enqueue failures, you should consider forcing a decision.The UOW Enqueue Analysis report may be used to obtain a list of all UOW IDs and their associated shunt times.Using either OMEMGAMON/CICS or the CICS CEMT transaction, you may perform the following actions against a shunted UOW:force backout, force commit, or force defined action."}

situation_name: CICSplex_UOWShuntTime_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for total shunt time
actions: {"If shunted UOWs are causing problems, such as holding locks that result in enqueue failures, you should consider forcing a decision.The UOW Enqueue Analysis report may be used to obtain a list of all UOW IDs and their associated shunt times.Using either OMEMGAMON/CICS or the CICS CEMT transaction, you may perform the following actions against a shunted UOW:force backout, force commit, or force defined action."}

situation_name: CICSplex_UOW_DSNFail_Warning
description: Dataset associated UOW has been shunted
actions: {"This Unit-of-work associated with this alert has been shunted because of a failure during syncpoint associated with the specified data set. You should be aware that failures during syncpoint processing may result in locks being retained by the UOW. This may result in system degradation if action is not taken to intervene and release the locked resources."}

situation_name: CICSplex_UOW_Link_Warning
description: Resynchronization Status is Unavailable or Unconnected
actions: {"A distributed Unit-of-work will be unable to resynchronise itself because the connection to its link partner is either unconnected or unavailable. To allow Resynchronisation to complete successfully you will have to set the connection to the remote system to acquired."}

situation_name: CICSplex_URIMAPDisCnt_Warning
description: URIMAP definition disabled during request
actions: {"The URIMAP associated with this alert is showing a disabled count greater than zero. One or more request against the host and path associated with this URIMAP were made while the URIMAP was disabled. Check your URIMAP definitions to ensure that the URIMAP is enabled, and consider enabling or redefining your URIMAP if necessary."}

situation_name: CICSplex_URIMAPHostDis_Warning
description: URIMAP associated Virtual Hosts are disabled
actions: {"The URIMAP associated with this alert is showing a Virtual Host disabled count greater than zero. This means that at least one search was made for a host and path for which the URIMAP definition was found, but the Virtual Host associated with the URIMAP was disabled. Check your Virtual Host definitions to ensure that the Virtual Host exists and that it is enabled, and consider redefining your URIMAP if necessary."}

situation_name: CICSplex_URIMAPStatus_Warning
description: URIMAP definition is disabled or unavailable
actions: {"The URIMAP associated with this alert is showing a status other than ENABLED. The URIMAP definition may be disabled or unavailable because the Virtual Host of which it is a part has been disabled. Check your URIMAP and Virtual Host definitions to ensure that the URIMAP and its associated Virtual Host are enabled, and enable or redefine them if necessary."}

situation_name: CICSplex_URIMAPUnmatch_Warning
description: URIMAP HOST/PATH search has failed
actions: {"The URIMAP associated with this alert is showing an unmatched count greater than zero. This means that at least one search was made for a matching URIMAP definition for which no host and path could be found. It may be necessary for you to review your current URIMAP definitions to ensure that the host and path specifications are correct."}

situation_name: CICSplex_VSAMDataCA_Critical
