situation_name: CICSplex_VSAMRLSTimeout_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for VSAM RLS timeouts
actions: {"Investigate tasks that may be holding an RLS lock for an excessive amount of time.The online history component of OMEGAMON/CICS can be used to identify transactions that have been abnormally terminated by CICS due to VSAM timeout conditions (abend code AFCV).If the lock activity is determined to be normal, consider increasing the DTIMOUT value for transactions that use the file, or the FTIMEOUT value defined to CICS."}

situation_name: CICSplex_VSAMRLSTimeout_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for VSAM RLS timeouts
actions: {"Investigate tasks that may be holding an RLS lock for an excessive amount of time.The online history component of OMEGAMON/CICS can be used to identify transactions that have been abnormally terminated by CICS due to VSAM timeout conditions (abend code AFCV).If the lock activity is determined to be normal, consider increasing the DTIMOUT value for transactions that use the file, or the FTIMEOUT value defined to CICS."}

situation_name: CICSplex_VSAMStrUse_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for VSAM string usage
actions: {"Use LSR pools so that strings and buffers are shared for all files.LSR may greatly reduce the total I/O and CPU usage in your system.If there are no evident problems, consider increasing the number of strings in the FCT."}

situation_name: CICSplex_VSAMStrUse_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for VSAM string usage
actions: {"Use LSR pools so that strings and buffers are shared for all files.LSR may greatly reduce the total I/O and CPU usage in your system.If there are no evident problems, consider increasing the number of strings in the FCT."}

situation_name: CICSplex_VSAMStrWait_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for VSAM string waits
actions: {"Consider using LSR pools so that strings and buffers are shared by files.LSR may greatly reduce the total I/O and CPU usage in your CICS region.Use the Transaction Analysis report to determine whether there is a problem that is preventing tasks from completing in a timely manner.For example, tasks may be waiting for an enqueue or CICS may be short-on-storage.If you determine that there is no bottleneck and the problem persists, consider increasing the number of VSAM strings."}

situation_name: CICSplex_VSAMStrWait_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for VSAM string waits
actions: {"Consider using LSR pools so that strings and buffers are shared by files.LSR may greatly reduce the total I/O and CPU usage in your CICS region.Use the Transaction Analysis report to determine whether there is a problem that is preventing tasks from completing in a timely manner.For example, tasks may be waiting for an enqueue or CICS may be short-on-storage.If you determine that there is no bottleneck and the problem persists, consider increasing the number of VSAM strings."}

situation_name: CICSplex_VSAMWaitvIO_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for VSAM waits versus I/O
actions: {"If a higher level of activity against the dataset has increased string waits, consider increasing the number of strings that are defined for the named dataset.Use LSR pools so that files share buffers and strings.LSR may reduce the total I/O and CPU usage in your CICS system.If a dataset is defined in an LSR pool, demand for strings may be reduced as a result of successful buffer lookasides."}

situation_name: CICSplex_VSAMWaitvIO_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for VSAM waits versus I/O
actions: {"If a higher level of activity against the dataset has increased string waits, consider increasing the number of strings that are defined for the named dataset.Use LSR pools so that files share buffers and strings.LSR may reduce the total I/O and CPU usage in your CICS system.If a dataset is defined in an LSR pool, demand for strings may be reduced as a result of successful buffer lookasides."}

situation_name: CICSplex_VTAMOpen_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for VTAM ACB open
actions: {"Check the startup messages in the CICS job log for an explanation of why the VTAM ACB failed to open.Check to make sure that the CICS VTAM ACB is active.If it is not, vary the ACB active with the VTAM vary command and issue the CEMT SET,VTAM,OPEN transaction in CICS to establish VTAM communications.If you are still having difficulty, contact the staff responsible for VTAM at your installation."}

situation_name: CICSplex_VTAMOpen_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for VTAM ACB open
actions: {"Check the startup messages in the CICS job log for an explanation of why the VTAM ACB failed to open.Check to make sure that the CICS VTAM ACB is active.If it is not, vary the ACB active with the VTAM vary command and issue the CEMT SET,VTAM,OPEN transaction in CICS to establish VTAM communications.If you are still having difficulty, contact the staff responsible for VTAM at your installation."}

situation_name: CICSplex_WLM_Blocks_Usage_High
description: WLM blocks usage is approaching maximum configured
actions: {"WLM blocks usage is approaching maximum configured. Use the OMEGAMON Service Task diagnostics report or the operator command F agentname,OC STATUS,WLMBLOCKS to determine the peak usage that the system has experienced for accumulation records. Use the configuration tool to adjust the WLM Blocks parameter so that a peak value of no more that 80% is ever experienced."}

situation_name: CICSplex_WebEnabled_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for Web interface disabled
actions: {"For Transaction Server 1.3 and later releases, specify TCPIP=YES in the CICS System Initialization Table to enable CICS Web support.If TS 1.2 is being monitored, use the CWBC transaction of CICS to enable the Web Interface.Releases of CICS prior to TS 1.2 do not support Web services and will always display a status of 'disabled'."}

situation_name: CICSplex_WebEnabled_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for Web interface disabled
actions: {"For Transaction Server 1.3 and later releases, specify TCPIP=YES in the CICS System Initialization Table to enable CICS Web support.If TS 1.2 is being monitored, use the CWBC transaction of CICS to enable the Web Interface.Releases of CICS prior to TS 1.2 do not support Web services and will always display a status of 'disabled'."}

situation_name: CICSplex_WebInstall_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for Web interface install
actions: {"A status of 'not installed' is only possible for the Transaction Server 1.2 release of CICS.Prior releases will always present a status of 'disabled', while later releases will indicate whether Web Support has been enabled.To support operation of the CICS Web Interface in TS 1.2, specify WEB=YES in the CICS System Initialization Table."}

situation_name: CICSplex_WebInstall_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for Web interface install
actions: {"A status of 'not installed' is only possible for the Transaction Server 1.2 release of CICS.Prior releases will always present a status of 'disabled', while later releases will indicate whether Web Support has been enabled.To support operation of the CICS Web Interface in TS 1.2, specify WEB=YES in the CICS System Initialization Table."}

situation_name: CICSplex_Web_Service_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded Webservice not inservice
actions: {"The WEBSERVICE identified in the alert is not INSERVICE. Determine why the WEBSERVICE is in this state and take the appropriate action. Thiscould be because the Web servicebinding file could not be installed inthe CICS region. Examine the CICS log and look for message DFHPI0914 WEBSERVICE WebService is unusable because the WSBIND file is corrupt. This could be caused by FTPing the file using ASCII instead of BINARY. To correct retransfer the file using BINARY, discard and reinstall the WEBSERVICE."}

situation_name: CICSplex_WorkSetHigh_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for high CICS working set
actions: {"Storage isolation values can be examined with the system summary display provided by OMEGAMON/CICS.If the working set size must be reduced, consider lowering the MXT value for CICS, using shared libraries, LPA residency options, VSAM LSR pools, or class max limits."}

situation_name: CICSplex_WorkSetHigh_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for high CICS working set
actions: {"Storage isolation values can be examined with the system summary display provided by OMEGAMON/CICS.If the working set size must be reduced, consider lowering the MXT value for CICS, using shared libraries, LPA residency options, VSAM LSR pools, or class max limits."}

situation_name: CICSplex_WorkSetLow_Critical
description: Critical threshold exceeded for low CICS working set
actions: {"Use the Transaction Analysis report to check whether there are any active transactions.If there is task activity, monitor the page-in rate with the Region Overview report.A low working set may be caused by frequent variations in the number of page-ins that CICS is doing.Consider storage isolation (set in the MVS IPS) to control the average CICS working set size."}

situation_name: CICSplex_WorkSetLow_Warning
description: Warning threshold exceeded for low CICS working set
actions: {"Use the Transaction Analysis report to check whether there are any active transactions.If there is task activity, monitor the page-in rate with the Region Overview report.A low working set may be caused by frequent variations in the number of page-ins that CICS is doing.Consider storage isolation (set in the MVS IPS) to control the average CICS working set size."}

situation_name: CICSplex_XML_Transform_Warning
description: XML Transform is not Enabled.
actions: {"The XML transform is not Enabled. It may be Disabled, Disabling (notavailable for further use, but inflight activity will be allowed to complete) or Enabling. You should review the CICS log for messages relating to the installation of the object, and take appropriate action."}

situation_name: CICSplex_delay_in_Database
description: Service Level failure with excessive time spent in database
actions: {"Use the historical transaction display function of OMEGAMON/CICS to locate the transactions that are responsible for the service level failure.Determine whether the large amount of time spent waiting on database activity is a consequence of either application changes or alterations in the database configuration.If the transaction behavior is found to be normal, consider updating the service class definitions so that they will accurately reflect anticipated response times."}

situation_name: CICSplex_delay_in_MQSeries
description: Service Level failure with excessive time spent in MQSeries
actions: {"Use the historical transaction display function of OMEGAMON/CICS to locate the transactions that are responsible for the service level failure.Determine whether the large amount of time spent waiting on MQ activity is a consequence of either application changes or alterations to the Message Queuing system.If the transaction behavior is found to be normal, consider updating the service class definitions so that they will accurately reflect anticipated response times."}

situation_name: CICSplex_delay_within_CICS
description: Service Level failure due to internal CICS components
actions: {"Use the historical transaction display function of OMEGAMON/CICS to locate the transactions that are responsible for the service level failure.The Bottleneck Analysis report may further assist in locating the wait reasons responsible for slow response time.If CPU bound transactions are unable to get the processor resources they need, consider increasing the priority of either the transaction or the CICS region."}

situation_name: Check_Missing_UNIX_Mount_Point
description: Raise critical alert if specified mount point is missing
actions: {"Root Directory missing. A system programmer should be notified."}

situation_name: Crypto_CKDS_80PCT_Full
description: The cryptographic key dataset is 80% full
actions: {"The Cryptographic Key Dataset (CKDS) is a VSAM linear dataset used to store keys used for encryption and authentication.The dataset is now at 80% of its maximum capacity.A new dataset should be created using a new master key and all keys contained in the full dataset should be reenciphered into the new dataset.The name of the current CKDS is shown in the CKDSname attribute.Refer to the ICSF Administration Guide for further details."}

situation_name: Crypto_CKDS_Access_Disabled
description: Access to CKDS is disabled
actions: {"Access to the cryptographic key dataset has been disabled.Access is normally disabled when a new master key or CKDS is being initialized. Access to the dataset should be temporary and enabled after key management operations are completed."}

situation_name: Crypto_Internal_Error
description: An internal monitoring error has occurred
actions: {"An internal monitor error has been detected.Contact IBM Software Support with the event attributes to report the error and for assistance in problem correction. MonStatus=Unknown indicates the KM5EXIT3 exit has not been installed in the ICSF subsystem. MonStatus=Overrun indicates that an internal queue overflow has been detected.This error can be cleared by recycling ICSF."}

situation_name: Crypto_Invalid_Master_Key
description: A valid master key has not been loaded into a coprocessor
actions: {"A valid master key must be loaded into at least one of the cryptographic coprocessors.Use the ICSF ISPF dialog, TKE, or the service element console to load the master key into each cryptographic coprocessor.A different master key may be loaded into coprocessors shared by PRSM Logical Partitions.Each LPAR is associated with a separate Domain Index to isolate cryptographic keys. For PCI coprocessors, the master key must be the same value as the Symmetric-keys Master Key (SYM-MK)."}

situation_name: Crypto_Invalid_PKA_Master_Keys
description: The public key algorthm master keys are invalid
actions: {"The Key Management Master Key (KMMK) and Signature Master Key (SMK) values are invalid.Ensure that the KMMK and SMK are loaded into each coprocessor.For PCI coprocessors, the SMK Key must be the same value used for the Asymmetric-keys Master Key (ASYM-MK).Use the KMMKey and SMKey attributes to validate the values of the verification hash patterns for these keys."}

situation_name: Crypto_No_Coprocessors
description: No cryptographic coprocessors are online
actions: {"At least one cryptographic coprocessor must be online for cryptographic services to become available.Verify that at least one coprocessor has been configured for the z/OS system.Use the service element console to configure coprocessors for use by systems."}

situation_name: Crypto_No_PCI_Coprocessors
description: No PCI cryptographic coprocessors are online
actions: {"No PCI cryptographic coprocessors are available.Several Public Key Algorithm (PKA) service calls will not function without a PCI coprocessor available.Since PCI coprocessors are optimized for PKA operations,PKA services will run slower on CMOS coprocessors."}

situation_name: Crypto_PCI_Unavailable
description: At least 1 PCI coprocessor is available but inactive
actions: {"At least one PCI coprocessor was detected but was not online or active. PCI coprocessors are optimized for Public Key Algorithm (PKA) operations and will run slower on CMOS coprocessors.Several PKA services will not run without a PCI coprocessor available. For PCI coprocessors, the SMK Key must be the same value used for the ASYM-MK. Also, The SYM-MK for each PCI coprocessor must be the same as the DES master key used on the CMOS coprocessors"}

situation_name: Crypto_PKA_Services_Disabled
description: Public Key Algorithm service calls are disabled
actions: {"The Public Key Algorithm (PKA) service calls are disabled.The services should only be disabled to update PKA Key Management Master Key(KMMK), Signature Master Key (SMK), or management of the Public Key Dataset(PKDS).PKA services calls should be enabled after PKA management operations are completed."}

situation_name: Crypto_PKDS_Read_Disabled
description: Read operations on the Public Key Dataset (PKDS) are disabled
actions: {"The Public Key Dataset (PKDS) is a VSAM dataset used to store Public Key Algorithm (PKA) keys used for encryption and authentication. Read operations have been temporarily disabled for management operations on the PKDS.Read access to the PKDS should be restored following completion of management operations.The PKDSname attribute display the name of the current PKDS"}

situation_name: Crypto_PKDS_Write_Disabled
description: Public Key Dataset (PKDS) write operations are disabled
actions: {"The Public Key Dataset (PKDS) is a VSAM dataset used to store Public Key Algorithm keys used for encryption and authentication.Write access to the dataset has been temporarily disabled to allow key management operations to occur.Write access should be enabled following completion of PKDS key management operations.The PKDSname attribute displays the name of the current PKDS."}

situation_name: Crypto_Service_Unavailable
description: Cryptographic services unavailable
actions: {"Cryptographic services are unavailable.Ensure that cryptographic coprocessors are online and available to this system. Also verify that a valid master key has been loaded in each coprocessor configured for this system."}

situation_name: DB2_CF_Connections_Warning
description: Data sharing is not active for this DB2 subsystem.
actions: {"When a DB2 member abnormally terminates, its connection to the coupling facility structures fails (Fail state).","Consult a DB2 system programmer to resolve the failure of the coupling facility connection."}

situation_name: DB2_CF_Structure_Use_Critical
description: The percentage of the coupling facility structure has exceeded the critical threshold.
actions: {"The usage of the coupling facility structure is too high. This has an impact on the response time and throughput of the data sharing members.","Consult a DB2 system programmer to increase the size of the coupling facility structure."}

situation_name: DB2_CF_Structure_Use_Warning
description: The percentage of the coupling facility structure has exceeded the warning threshold.
actions: {"The usage of the coupling facility structure is too high. This has an impact on the response time and throughput of the data sharing members.","Consult a DB2 system programmer to increase the size of the coupling facility structure."}

situation_name: DB2_CMD_Connection_Failed
description: This message is displayed when data sharing is not active for a DB2 system.
actions: {"When a DB2 member abnormally terminates, its connection tothe coupling facility structures fails (Fail state).","Consult a DB2 system programmer to resolve the failure of the coupling facility connection."}

situation_name: DB2_CMD_Group_BP_READ_Hit_Warn
description: This message is displayed when \"Read hit %\" exceeds the warning threshold.
actions: {"The percentage of all Reads to the group buffer pool (Read hit %) is decreasing. The purpose of the buffer pool is to try to avoid disk I/O.Your buffer pool is efficient if you have a high hit ratio (ideally, over 99%).","You might need to resize your buffer pool or re-balance buffer pool usage by moving table spaces to a buffer pool with less usage."}

situation_name: DB2_CMD_Lock_Wait_Time_Critical
description: This message is displayed when the lock elapsed time exceeds 10 seconds.
actions: {"A thread has been waiting for a resource longer than the critical threshold.","You might want to find the resource owner and the owner application to determine the cause of the long lock wait time and take corrective action."}

situation_name: DB2_CMD_Thrd_Wait_Time_Critical
description: This message is displayed when the thread wait time exceeds 10 seconds.
actions: {"This thread has been waiting for a resource longer than the critical threshold.","You might want to find the resource owner and the owner application to determine the cause of the long lock wait time and take corrective action."}

situation_name: DB2_Group_BP_Read_Hit_Critical
description: The Group BP read hit ratio has exceeded the critical threshold.
actions: {"The percentage of all Reads to the group buffer pool (Read hit %) is below the threshold. The purpose of the buffer pool is to try to avoid disk I/O.","You might need to resize your buffer pool or re-balance buffer pool usage by moving table spaces to a buffer pool with less usage."}

situation_name: DB2_Group_BP_Read_Hit_Warning
description: The Group BP read hit ratio has exceeded the warning threshold.
actions: {"The percentage of all Reads to the group buffer pool (Read hit %) is in a warning threshold.The purpose of the buffer pool is to try to avoid disk I/O.","You might need to resize your buffer pool or re-balance buffer pool usage by moving table spaces to a buffer pool with less usage."}

situation_name: DB2_Lock_Waiter_Time_Critical
description: The lock waiter elapsed time has exceeded the critical threshold.
actions: {"A thread has been waiting for a resource longer than the critical threshold.","You might want to find the resource owner and the owner application to determine the cause of the long lock wait time and take corrective action."}

situation_name: DB2_Lock_Waiter_Time_Warning
description: The lock waiter elapsed time has exceeded the warning threshold.
actions: {"A thread has been waiting for a resource longer than the warning threshold.","You might want to find the resource owner and the owner application to determine the cause of the long lock wait time and take corrective action."}

situation_name: DB2_Plex_Heartbeat
description: Heartbeat situation to detect DB2 data sharing groups.
actions: {"This situation should never be raised."}

situation_name: DB2_Thread_Wait_Time_Critical
description: The DB2 thread wait time has exceeded the critical threshold.
actions: {"This thread has been waiting for a resource longer than the critical threshold.","You might want to find the resource owner and the owner application to determine the cause of the long lock wait time and take corrective action."}

situation_name: DB2_Thread_Wait_Time_Warning
description: The DB2 thread wait time has exceeded the warning threshold.
actions: {"This thread has been waiting for a resource longer than the warning threshold.","You might want to find the resource owner and the owner application to determine the cause of the long lock wait time and take corrective action."}

situation_name: Excess_Process_UNIX_Run_Time
description: Detect when a process exceeds 50% UNIX run time
actions: {"CPU utilization attributable to UNIX work for the indicated Process exceeds the current threshold defined as excessive.This condition may or may not be a matter of immediate concern.It may indicate the Process is in a loop requesting UNIX System Services."}

situation_name: Excess_UNIX_Kernel_CPU_Time
description: Detect when the UNIX kernel is using more than 50% CPU
actions: {"UNIX System Services Kernel CPU utilization exceeds the current threshold defined as excessive.This condition may or may not be a matter of immediate concern.It may indicate a Process or address space in a loop requesting Kernel services.Look for Processes or addresses spaces with abnormally high CPU utilization."}

situation_name: Excess_UNIX_System_Time
description: Detect when a dubbed address space exceeds 50% UNIX system time
actions: {"CPU utilization attributable to execution of z/OS UNIX System Services Kernel code exceeds the current threshold defined as excessive.This condition may or may not be a matter of immediate concern.It may indicate the Address Space is in a loop requesting UNIX System Services."}

situation_name: Excess_UNIX_User_Time
description: Detect when a dubbed address space exceeds 50% UNIX user time
actions: {"Address Space CPU utilization attributable to UNIX work exceeds the current threshold defined as excessive.This condition may or may not be a matter of immediate concern.It may indicate the Address Space is in a loop."}

situation_name: Free_Space_in_zFS_User_Cache
description: Free Space in the zFS User Cache has dropped below 5,000 pages. The zFS user file cache is used to cache all \"regular\" files. It caches any file, of any size, and performs write-behind and asynchronous read-ahead for files. The zFS user file cache performs I/O for all filesthat are 7K or larger.
actions: {"The User Cache is allocated in data spaces. Its default size is 256MB. The maximum sizeis 65,536MB (64GB). The Free_Space_In_zFS_User_Cache Situation monitors the number ofavailable free pages in the cache. You can use the MVS modify command (F zfs,query,{…}) to verify if the situation is accompanied by a low hit ratio (less than 80%). If this happens frequently, you may want to increase the value of the user_cache_size configuration parameter."}

situation_name: HACMP_acquire_service_addr
description: Changes boot address to the corresponding service address.
actions: {"Changes a boot address to the corresponding service addressand starts TCP/IP servers and network daemons by running thetelinit a command.HACMP modifies the /etc/inittab file bysetting all the TCP/IP related startup records to a run level ofa."}

situation_name: HACMP_acquire_takeover_addr
description: Acquires takeover IP address by checking configured standby.
actions: {"Acquires takeover IP address by checking configured standbyaddresses and swapping them with failed service addresses."}

situation_name: HACMP_config_too_long
description: Node has been in reconfiguration for more than six minutes.
actions: {"Sends a periodic console message when a node has beenin reconfiguration for more than six minutes."}

situation_name: HACMP_event_error
description: Occurs when an HACMP event script fails for some reason.
actions: {"Occurs when an HACMP event script fails for some reason."}

situation_name: HACMP_fail_standby
description: Standby network adapter failed or is no longer available.
actions: {"Sends a console message when a standby adapter fails or is nolonger available because it has been used to take over the IPaddress of another adapter."}

situation_name: HACMP_get_disk_vg_fs
description: Acquire system resources as part of a takeover.
actions: {"Acquire disk, volume group and file system resources as partof a takeover."}

situation_name: HACMP_join_standby
description: Standby network adapter is available.
actions: {"Sends a console message when a standby adapter becomesavailable."}

situation_name: HACMP_network_down
description: Occurs when the cluster determines that a network has failed.
actions: {"Occurs when the cluster determines that a network has failed.The event script provided takes no default action, since theappropriate action will be site- or LAN-specific."}

situation_name: HACMP_network_down_complete
description: Occurs after a network down event has successfully completed.
actions: {"Occurs only after a network_down event has successfullycompleted.The event script provided takes no default action, since the appropriate action will be site- or LAN-specific."}

situation_name: HACMP_network_up
description: Occurs when the cluster determines that a network is available.
actions: {"Occurs when the cluster determines that a network has becomeavailable.The event script provided takes no default action,since the appropriate action will be site- or LAN-specific."}

situation_name: HACMP_network_up_complete
description: Occurs when a network up event has successfully completed.
actions: {"Occurs when a network_up_event has successfully completed.The event script provided takes no default action, since the appropriate action will be site- or LAN-specific."}

situation_name: HACMP_node_down
description: Occurs when a node is detaching from the cluster.
actions: {"Occurs when a node is detaching from the cluster, eithervoluntarily or due to a failure.Depending on whether thenode is local or remote, either the node_down_local ornode_down_remote sub-event is called."}

situation_name: HACMP_node_down_complete
description: Occurs when a node_down event has successfully completed.
actions: {"Occurs only after a node_down event has successfullycompleted.Depending on whether the node is local or remote, either the node_down_local or node_down_remote_complete sub-event is called."}

situation_name: HACMP_node_down_local
description: Releases resources taken from a remote node and stops application server.
actions: {"Releases resources taken from a remote node, stops application servers, releases a service address taken from a remote node, releases concurrent volume groups, unmounts file systems and reconfigures the node to its boot address."}

situation_name: HACMP_node_down_local_complete
description: Instructs the cluster manager to exit.
actions: {"Instructs the cluster manager to exit when the localnode has completed detaching from the cluster.This eventonly occurs after a node_down_local event has successfully completed."}

situation_name: HACMP_node_down_remote
description: Places concurrent volume group in a non-concurrent mode.
actions: {"Unmounts any NFS file systems and places a concurrentvolume group in non-concurrent mode when the local node isthe only surviving node in the cluster.If the failed nodedid not go down gracefully, acquires the failed node's resources:file systems, volume groups, disks and service address."}

situation_name: HACMP_node_down_rmt_complete
description: Starts application server takeover.
actions: {"Starts application server takeover if the remote nodedid not go down gracefully.This event only occurs after node_down_remote event has successfully completed."}

situation_name: HACMP_node_up
description: Occurs when a node is joining the cluster.
actions: {"Occurs when a node is joining the cluster.Depending onwhether the node is local or remote, either the node_up_localor node_up_remote sub-event is called."}

situation_name: HACMP_node_up_complete
description: Occurs only after a node_up event has successfully completed.
actions: {"Occurs only after a node_up has successfully completed. Depending on whether the node is local or remote, eithernode_up_local_complete or node_up_remote_complete sub-eventis called."}

situation_name: HACMP_node_up_local
description: Occurs when the local node attaches to the cluster.
actions: {"When the local node attaches to the cluster: acquires theservices address, clears the application server file,acquires file systems, volume groups and disk resources,exports file systems and either activates concurrentvolume groups or puts them into concurrent mode, dependingupon the status of the remote nodes."}

situation_name: HACMP_node_up_local_complete
description: Starts application servers and checks for a takeover.
actions: {"Starts application servers and then checks to see if an inactive takeover is needed.This event only occurs after node_up_local event has successfully completed."}

situation_name: HACMP_node_up_remote
description: Causes the local node to release all resources.
actions: {"Causes the local node to do an NFS mount only after the remote node starts. Also places the concurrent volume groupsinto concurrent mode."}

situation_name: HACMP_node_up_remote_complete
description: Allows the local node to do an NFS mount.
actions: {"Allows the local node to do an NFS mount only after the remote node is completely up.This event only occurs aftera node_up_remote event has successfully completed."}

situation_name: HACMP_release_service_addr
description: Detaches the service address and configures the boot address.
actions: {"Detaches the service address and reconfigures it to its boot address."}

situation_name: HACMP_release_takeover_addr
description: Identifies a takeover address to be released.
actions: {"Identifies a takeover address to be released because astandby adapter on the local node is masquerading as the service address of the remote node. Reconfigures the local standby into its original role."}

situation_name: HACMP_release_vg_fs
description: Releases volume groups and file systems.
actions: {"Releases volume groups and file systems that the local nodetook from the remote node."}

situation_name: HACMP_start_server
description: Starts application servers.
actions: {"Starts application servers."}

situation_name: HACMP_stop_server
description: Stops application servers.
actions: {"Stops application servers."}

situation_name: HACMP_swap_adapter
description: Exchanges or swaps the IP addresses of two network interfaces.
actions: {"Exchanges or swaps the IP addresses of two network interfaces.NIS and name serving are temporarily turned off during the event."}

situation_name: HACMP_swap_adapter_complete
description: Occurs after a swap_adapter event has successfully finished.
actions: {"Occurs only after a swap_adapter event has successfullycompleted.Ensures that the local ARP cache is updated bydeleting entries and pinging cluster IP addresses."}

situation_name: IBM_i_IOA_Cache_Battery_Error
description: Monitors for the failure of I/O adapter card cache batteries.System performance degradation may be a problem when cache batteries fail.
actions: {"Replace the I/O adapter card cache batteries as soon as possible."}

situation_name: IBM_i_IOA_Cache_Battery_Warning
description: Monitors for failure of I/O adapter card cache batteries within the next 30 days.Battery failure can cause system performancedegradation.
actions: {"Replace the I/O adapter card cache battery prior to failure to ensure system performance degradation does not occur."}

situation_name: IMS_BP_Locked_Count
description: Locked buffer pool pages
actions: {"The number of buffer pool pages locked has exceeded the threshold. Locked buffers will reduce the amount of storage available to the system, however they will also insure that the access to the data in the buffer is faster since the pages will be in memory. This is not a real problem unless your system has real storage constraints that are impacting other applications."}

situation_name: IMS_CMD_CF_RLE_Pct_Critical
description: CF RLE percent used exceeded the critical threshold.
actions: {"More than 90% of the RLEs (Resource List Entries) in the Coupling facility are used. Operation of IMS may be severely impacted if RLE usage reaches 100%. Actions: Identify the transaction(s) using the highest number of RLEs and terminate one or more of them. Redesign the transaction to use less RLEs. Increase the number of RLEs in the Coupling Facility,"}

situation_name: IMS_CMD_Lock_Wait_Time_Critical
description: Lock waiter elapsed time has exceeded the critical threshold.
actions: {"A transaction is waiting for more than 7 seconds for a resource. Action: Identify the owner of the resource. If one of the involved transactions is not working correctly, terminate it. Perhaps redesign it to use resources more efficiently."}

situation_name: IMS_CMD_MQ_STATUS_Critical
description: MQ Status critical warning for MQ Subsystems not connected
actions: {"The connection to an MQ (Message Queuing) Subsystem is broken. Action: Reestablish the connection."}

situation_name: IMS_CMD_MSC_Q_Count_Critical
description: MSC Q count has exceeded the critical threshold
actions: {"The number of messages waiting to be sent on a Multiple System Coupling (MSC) link is equal or greater than the threshold of 55. Action: Examine the status of the MSC link. Take actions to make the link operational again in case it is down."}

situation_name: IMS_CMD_RTA_Group_Resp_Critical
description: RTA Group has exceeded the critical threshold
actions: {"The R0 response time of an RTA group has exceeded 2 seconds or the R1 response time has exceeded 7 seconds. Action: Determine the reason for the bad response time (transaction waiting for a resource, bad design, ...)"}

situation_name: IMS_CPU_High_Critical
description: Regions using high CPU
actions: {"The address space identified in the exception is using a higher percent of CPU than the specified threshold. This could be an indication of a run away task or that the region is in the middle of error recovery. If this condition persists, look at the job logs for the started task to determine if the region is abending."}

situation_name: IMS_CPU_High_Warning
description: Regions using high CPU
actions: {"The address space identified in the exception is using a higher percent of CPU than the specified threshold. This could be an indication of a run away task or that the region is in the middle of error recovery. If this condition persists, look at the job logs for the started task to determine if the region is abending."}

situation_name: IMS_CPU_Low_Critical
description: Regions using low CPU
actions: {"The address space identified in the exception is using a CPU percentage less than the specified threshold. This could be an indication that part or all of your IMS system has stalled. If the problem persists, verify that all regions are active and are in a normal status."}

situation_name: IMS_CPU_Low_Warning
description: Regions using low CPU
actions: {"The address space identified in the exception is using a CPU percentage less than the specified threshold. This could be an indication that part or all of your IMS system has stalled. If the problem persists, verify that all regions are active and are in a normal status."}

situation_name: IMS_Common_PageIn_High_Critical
description: Common storage page in rate high
actions: {"The address space identified in the exception is causing high page in rates for common storage. This could be an indication of a problem with an application using too much common storage or possibly looping.If this condition persists, look at the job logs for the started task to determine if the region is abending."}

situation_name: IMS_Common_PageIn_High_Warning
description: Common storage page in rate high
actions: {"The address space identified in the exception is causing high page in rates for common storage. This could be an indication of a problem with an application using too much common storage or possibly looping.If this condition persists, look at the job logs for the started task to determine if the region is abending."}

situation_name: IMS_Connect_NAK_Response_High
description: IMS Connect Negative Responses High
actions: {"This situation triggers when the number of Negative Acknowledgements (NAKs) exceeds the threshold. The NAK can be generated either from the client or via OTMA. Determine whether the NAK originates in the client or OTMA by displaying the detail for the problem transaction. The OTMA_NAK_Sense_Code column will contain the sense code if the NAK originated from OTMA. From the sense code, determine the proper course of action."}

situation_name: IMS_Connect_Port_Avg_Depth_High
description: IMS Connect Port Average Depth High
actions: {"This situation triggers when the average depth on socket exceeds the threshold.Determine the MAXSOC setting on the IMS Connect HWS configuration member for the specific HWSID.The MAXSOC determines the maximum number of sockets that IMS Connect can open.Also refer to member BPXPRMxx in SYS1.PARMLIB.The MAXSOCKETS parameter sets a limit for the total number of sockets in a system, and MAXFILEPROC sets the maximum number of sockets for any job."}

situation_name: IMS_Connect_Port_Max_Depth_High
description: IMS Connect Port Maximum Depth High
actions: {"This situation triggers when the maximum depth on socket exceeds the threshold.Determine the MAXSOC setting on the IMS Connect HWS configuration member for the specific HWSID.The MAXSOC determines the maximum number of sockets that IMS Connect can open.Also refer to member BPXPRMxx in SYS1.PARMLIB.The MAXSOCKETS parameter sets a limit for the total number of sockets in a system, and MAXFILEPROC sets the maximum number of sockets for any job."}

situation_name: IMS_Connect_Response_Time_High
description: IMS Connect Response Time High
actions: {"This situation triggers when the average response time for a given transaction exceeds the threshold.Identify the response time component responsible for the majority of the time.These response time components will be one of: Input Pre-OTMA, Input Read Exit, Input SAF, Process OTMA, Output Confirm, Output Post-OTMA, or Output Exit Times."}

situation_name: IMS_Connect_Tran_MsgRate_High
description: IMS Connect Transaction Message Rate High
actions: {"This situation triggers when the number of transactions per second processed through IMS Connect exceeds the threshold.This can occur for several reasons.Temporary spikes in transaction throughput could be indications of errors in the client application.Display the Response Time Summary by Client workspace to identify this type of problem client."}

situation_name: IMS_DB_Dyn_Backout_Error
description: Database dynamic back out error
actions: {"The IMS system has had a problem when trying to dynamically backout of a change to a database. When this exception occurs, you should verify that the database identified by the exception is still usable and contains the correct data."}

situation_name: IMS_DB_IO_Errors
description: Database Write error
actions: {"The IMS system had a write error when trying to update the database identified in this exception. This database should be examined to determine if the data is still usable and valid."}

situation_name: IMS_DEDB_Error
description: DEDB write error
actions: {"The IMS system had a write error when trying to update a data entry database. The DEDB should be examined to determine if the data is still usable and valid."}

situation_name: IMS_DS_IORate_High_Critical
description: Dataset I/O Rate high
actions: {"The system dataset identified in this exception has an I/O rate higher then the specified threshold. High I/O rates could impact the performance of the IMS system. If this persists, you should verify that the dataset being used and the region using it are not having problems."}

situation_name: IMS_DS_IORate_High_Warning
description: Dataset I/O Rate high
actions: {"The system dataset identified in this exception has an I/O rate higher then the specified threshold. High I/O rates could impact the performance of the IMS system. If this persists, you should verify that the dataset being used and the region using it are not having problems."}

situation_name: IMS_DepRegDLETCallHigh
description: Number of DLET Calls for a Dependent Region is High
actions: {"This dependent region has been identified as having done more than 100 DLET calls. This may indicate a looping transaction."}

situation_name: IMS_DepRegDLICallHigh

situation_name: IMS_DepRegDLICallsPerTransHigh

description: Number of GNP Calls for a Dependent Region is High
actions: {"This dependent region has been identified as having done more than 100 GNP calls. This may indicate a looping transaction."}

situation_name: IMS_DepRegGUCallHigh

actions: {"This dependent region has been identified as having done more than 10 Message ISRT calls. This may indicate a looping transaction."}

description: Number of Message PURG Calls for a Dependent Region is High

actions: {"This dependent region has been identified as having done more than 100 REPL calls. This may indicate a looping transaction."}

situation_name: IMS_DepRegSwappedOut
description: Dependent region swapped out
actions: {"The dependent region identified by this exception is currently swapped out of memory. This will cause delays the next time the dependent region is needed since all of its pages will need to be brought back into main storage. If the performance of the applications using this region is critical, then you may want to consider making this region non-swappable."}

situation_name: IMS_DepReg_Long_Lock_Wait
description: Dependent region in long lock wait
actions: {"This situation triggers for a Dependent Region when the region is waiting too long for an IRLM or PI lock. The Dependent Regions and Lock Conflicts workspaces can be used to identify the application owning the resource and the top blocking application. Use application trace to help determine why the top blocking application is holding the resource too long, and if necessary, cancel the application."}

situation_name: IMS_DepReg_OTMA_ACKNAK_Warning
description: Waiting on an ACK/NAK for OTMA TPIPE
actions: {"This situation triggers for a Dependent Region when an OTMA TPIPE is waiting for an ACK or NAK for a commit-then-send, CM0, output response.If this event persists, the OTMA client should be investigated to determine why an ACK/NAK response is not occurring or is taking too long."}

situation_name: IMS_DepReg_Occupancy_High
description: Region Occupancy for Dependent Region is High
actions: {"This dependent region has been identified as being utilized 100.00%. Perhaps additional regions must be started."}

situation_name: IMS_DepReg_Occupancy_Low
description: Region Occupancy for Dependent Region is Low
actions: {"This dependent region has been identified as being utilized 0.00%. Perhaps this region can be stopped."}

situation_name: IMS_DeviceErrorRecovery
description: Device in I/O error recovery
actions: {"The device identified in this exception is currently in an I/O error recovery state. The system will normally correct itself on this type of a condition. However; if it is happening too frequently, the overall performance of your IMS applications could suffer or you may experience loss of data. The hardware device should be checked by the hardware vendor to insure that it is working properly."}

situation_name: IMS_DeviceNotReady
description: Device not ready
actions: {"The device identified in this exception is currently not ready. If this is a tape drive, it may simply be a matter of waiting for the current long running operation to complete. If the problem persists, you should contact operations to see if they can investigate what is happening with the device."}

situation_name: IMS_DeviceNotResponding
description: Device not responding
actions: {"The device identified in this exception has not completed an I/O operation since the last time the device was tested. This is an indication that it is not responding and the condition should be checked by operations."}

situation_name: IMS_ExSubNoCtl
description: DB2 subsystem not defined in control region
actions: {"The DB2 subsystem has been defined to the dependent region, but the control region does not know about it. This is typically a configuration problem that should be discussed with the administrator of the IMS system."}

situation_name: IMS_ExSubNoDep
description: DB2 subsystem not defined in dependent region
actions: {"The DB2 subsystem has been defined to the control region, but the dependent region identified in the exception does not know about it. This is typically a configuration problem that should be discussed with the administrator of the IMS system."}

situation_name: IMS_HALDB_Part_Not_Initialized
description: A HALDB partition is in the Not Initialized state
actions: {"This partition has not been initialized. You will need to initialize the partition before it can be used."}

situation_name: IMS_HALDB_Partition_Stopped
description: A HALDB Partition is in the stopped state
actions: {"This partition has been identified as being in a stopped state. If this is not intentional, you will want to start the partition."}

situation_name: IMS_Held_Locks_Critical
description: Held locks high
actions: {"The total number of locks held has exceeded the threshold. When the lock held count becomes too high, it increases the chances that there will be lock contention and therefore causes performance degradation. If one application is consuming most of the locks, you may want to verify that the application is not in a state where it cannot release the locks it currently holds."}

situation_name: IMS_Held_Locks_Warning
description: Held locks high
actions: {"The total number of locks held has exceeded the threshold. When the lock held count becomes too high, it increases the chances that there will be lock contention and therefore causes performance degradation. If one application is consuming most of the locks, you may want to verify that the application is not in a state where it cannot release the locks it currently holds."}

situation_name: IMS_IRLM_CF_RLE_Percent_Crit
description: CF RLE percent used exceeded the critical threshold.
actions: {"More than 90% of the RLEs (Resource List Entries) in the Coupling facility are used. Operation of IMS may be severely impacted if RLE usage reaches 100%. Actions: Identify the transaction(s) using the highest number of RLEs and terminate one or more of them. Redesign the transaction to use less RLEs. Increase the number of RLEs in the Coupling Facility,"}

situation_name: IMS_IRLM_CF_RLE_Percent_Warning
description: CF RLE percent used exceeded the warning threshold.
actions: {"Between 80 and 90% of the RLEs (Resource List Entries) in the Coupling facility are in use. Operation of IMS may be severely impacted if RLE usage reaches 100%. Actions: Identify the transaction(s) using the highest number of RLEs and terminate one or more of them. Redesign the transaction to use less RLEs. Increase the number of RLEs in the Coupling Facility,"}

situation_name: IMS_IRLM_Contention_Critical
description: High data-sharing contention rates
actions: {"The contention rate for data-sharing has exceeded the threshold. This may be an indication that an application is holding onto a lock longer then it needs to. The locking reports in IMSPLEX can be used to determine the owners and waiters for global locks."}

situation_name: IMS_IRLM_Contention_Warning
description: High data-sharing contention rates
actions: {"The contention rate for data-sharing has exceeded the threshold. This may be an indication that an application is holding onto a lock longer then it needs to. The locking reports in IMSPLEX can be used to determine the owners and waiters for global locks."}

situation_name: IMS_IRLM_Inactive
description: IRLM not available
actions: {"The IRLM system is inactive for this IMS. This may be valid if you are not using IRLM as your lock manager. If the IRLM is required, investigate the started task that is supposed to run IRLM to insure that it is functioning properly. You may need to simply restart the IRLM job."}

situation_name: IMS_IRLM_Not_Connected
description: IRLM not connected to data-sharing group
actions: {"The IRLM system has not connected to the data-sharing group. Until this occurs, you will not be able to share data across a coupling facility. You should check the IRLM job to see if it is running properly and contact IBM support if it is failing to connect to a properly configured coupling facility."}

situation_name: IMS_IRLM_Utilization_Critical
description: IRLM use of RLEs is high
actions: {"The IRLM system uses an RLE control block for keeping track of lock owners and waiters. There is a finite number of these control blocks available. If the utilization of this area goes to 100%, then requests for locks in the IRLM will fail causing either delays in the applications or termination of those applications. The applications currently holding the locks should be verified to make sure they are acting properly and releasing the locks after they are done with the pages."}

situation_name: IMS_IRLM_Utilization_Warning
description: IRLM use of RLEs is high
actions: {"The IRLM system uses an RLE control block for keeping track of lock owners and waiters. There is a finite number of these control blocks available. If the utilization of this area goes to 100%, then requests for locks in the IRLM will fail causing either delays in the applications or termination of those applications. The applications currently holding the locks should be verified to make sure they are acting properly and releasing the locks after they are done with the pages."}

situation_name: IMS_Inactive
description: IMS system in shutdown
actions: {"This exception will trip if the IMS system is currently in shutdown status, but has not yet completed. If this condition persists, it may be an indication that one or more of the regions associated with the IMS system has abended during the shutdown process."}

situation_name: IMS_LU_Status
description: LU inactive
actions: {"The logical unit status is inactive, which is an indication that many of your physical terminals will not be able to connect to the IMS system. The VTAM system should be checked to make sure it is functioning properly."}

situation_name: IMS_Largest_Freeblock_Critical
description: Pool Largest Free Space Low
actions: {"The pool identified in this exception has exceeded the threshold for largest free storage area. When the largest area available becomes too small to handle the request, applications can stall or terminate. You can address this issue by reducing the amount of work being requested or increasing the amount of storage available in the pool."}

situation_name: IMS_Largest_Freeblock_Warning
description: Pool Largest Free Space Low
actions: {"The pool identified in this exception has exceeded the threshold for largest free storage area. When the largest area available becomes too small to handle the request, applications can stall or terminate. You can address this issue by reducing the amount of work being requested or increasing the amount of storage available in the pool."}

situation_name: IMS_Lock_Conflict_TopBlocker
description: The top blocker for a conflict has been recognized
actions: {"Lock conflicts have been detected and the lock owner that is not waiting on other locks has been identified. This lock owner is considered the top blocker and should be examined to see if this conflict is impacting your system. If so, and the job does not need to be holding the locks, you may be able to cancel the job or transaction identified."}

situation_name: IMS_LogTape_Writeahead
description: Write ahead facility not active
actions: {"The Write Ahead capability enables the system to write data quicker by insuring that the resources needed for writing the data are available. If this facility is not active, then some writes will take longer to perform. The configuration for the IMS system should be checked to insure that write ahead is enabled."}

situation_name: IMS_Logging_AutoArchive
description: Logging dataset inactive
actions: {"The logging facility is currently inactive. This is not a good state to be in since you will loose the ability to recover your data in case of errors. Check with the IMS administrator to make sure that the logging facility is properly defined."}

situation_name: IMS_Logging_DS_Error
description: Logging dataset had I/O error
actions: {"The dataset identified in the exception has had an I/O error while trying to read or write logging information to it. Since logging information is critical for recovery, this state should be avoided. You may want to replace the dataset used for logging if this problem persists."}

situation_name: IMS_Logging_WriteAhead
description: Write ahead disabled
actions: {"The Write Ahead capability enables the system to write data quicker by insuring that the resources needed for writing the data are available. If this facility is not active, then some writes will take longer to perform. The configuration for the IMS system should be checked to insure that write ahead is enabled."}

situation_name: IMS_MSC_Link_Byte_Rec_Rate_High
description: MSC Link Bytes Receive Rate High
actions: {"The number of bytes received per second exceeds the threshold.This may indicate a runaway transaction."}

situation_name: IMS_MSC_Link_Byte_SendRate_High
description: MSC Link Bytes Send Rate High
actions: {"The number of bytes per second exceeds the threshold.This may indicate a runaway transaction."}

situation_name: IMS_MSC_Link_Rec_IO_Rate_High
description: MSC Link Receive I/O Rate High
actions: {"The number of receive I/Os per second exceeds the threshold.This may indicate a runaway transaction."}

situation_name: IMS_MSC_Link_Send_IO_Rate_High
description: MSC Link Send I/O Rate High
actions: {"The number of send I/Os per second exceeds the threshold.This may indicate a runaway transaction."}

situation_name: IMS_MSC_Queue_Count_Critical
description: MSC queue count has exceeded the critical threshold.
actions: {"The number of messages waiting to be sent on a Multiple System Coupling (MSC) link is equal or greater than the threshold of 100. Action: Examine the status of the MSC link. Take actions to make the link operational again in case it is down."}

situation_name: IMS_MSC_Queue_Count_Warning
description: MSC queue count has exceeded the warning threshold.
actions: {"The number of messages waiting to be sent on a Multiple System Coupling (MSC) link is between 50 and 99. Action: This is a Warning; no immediate action required. Watch the MSC link."}

situation_name: IMS_MSC_Queue_Status
description: The MSC Queue is not operational
actions: {"An MSC link is not open. Action: Activate it with command /ACTIVATE LINK link#. Contact your Network (VTAM) specialist, if this does not resolve the problem."}

situation_name: IMS_OLDS_IO_Errors_Critical
description: Logging datasets with I/O errors
actions: {"The number of Online Logging datasets that have had I/O errors has exceeded the limit. This is an indication that you may be having problems with the DASD devices where the datasets reside. You should check to see what types of errors are being reported for the devices and move the datasets to devices that are more stable."}

situation_name: IMS_OLDS_One_Active
description: Only one online logging dataset
actions: {"The count of Online Logging Datasets is one. This means that there will be no place to write the logging information once this dataset fills up. The system configuration should be checked to make sure multiple online datasets are defined and that they are available to the IMS system."}

situation_name: IMS_OSAM_Rate_High_Critical
description: OSAM dataset I/O rate high
actions: {"The OSAM dataset I/O rate has exceeded the threshold. When the rate for any database is high, it could cause the applications to slow down since they would end up sitting in an I/O wait status. The application should be checked to insure that it is running properly."}

situation_name: IMS_OSAM_Rate_High_Warning
description: OSAM dataset I/O rate high
actions: {"The OSAM dataset I/O rate has exceeded the threshold. When the rate for any database is high, it could cause the applications to slow down since they would end up sitting in an I/O wait status. The application should be checked to insure that it is running properly."}

situation_name: IMS_OTMA_TIBs_In_Use_Critical
description: IMS OTMA TIBs In Use Critical
actions: {"This situation triggers when the percentage of TIBs (Transaction Instance Blocks) in use for a TMEMBER is 80% or higher. Corrective action may be needed in order to prevent an OTMA flood condition which occurs when the number of TIBs in use is 100%. TMEMBER input is rejected until the flood condition is relieved. TIB growth can occur due to a stopped program, unavailable message region, message arrival rate exceeds processing rate, or failure to generate a CM1 IOPCB response leaving orphanned TIBs."}

situation_name: IMS_OTMA_TIBs_In_Use_Warning
description: IMS OTMA TIBs In Use Warning
actions: {"This situation triggers when the percentage of TIBs (Transaction Instance Blocks) in use for a TMEMBER is between 70% and 80%. Corrective action may be needed to prevent an OTMA flood condition which occurs when the number of TIBs in use is 100%. TMEMBER input is rejected until the flood condition is relieved. TIB growth can occur due to a stopped program, unavailable message region, message arrival rate exceeds processing rate, or failure to generate a CM1 IOPCB response leaving orphanned TIBs."}

situation_name: IMS_OTMA_TMEMBER_In_Flood
description: IMS OTMA TMEMBER in Flood Condition
actions: {"This situation triggers when an OTMA TMEMBER is in a flood condition. A flood condition occurs when the percentage of TIBs (Transaction Instance Blocks) in use for a TMEMBER reaches 100%. Corrective action must be taken to relieve the flood condition as input is rejected for the TMEMBER until the condition is relieved. TIB growth can occur due to a stopped program, unavailable message region, message arrival rate exceeds processing rate, or failure to generate a CM1 IOPCB response leaving orphanned TIBs."}

situation_name: IMS_OTMA_TPIPE_Output_Que_High
description: IMS OTMA TPIPE Output Queue Count High
actions: {"This situation triggers when the output queue count for a TPIPE exceeds the indicated threshold."}

situation_name: IMS_OTMA_TPIPE_Stopped
description: IMS OTMA TPIPE is stopped
actions: {"This situation triggers when a TPIPE is stopped.A stopped TPIPE has a status of stopped or input stopped.Determine why the TPIPE has a stopped status and restart the TPIPE."}

situation_name: IMS_OTMA_TPIPE_Wait_ACK_NAK
description: IMS OTMA TPIPE waiting on ACK or NAK
actions: {"This situation triggers when a TPIPE is waiting for an ACK or NAK for a commit-then-send, CM0, output response.If this event persists for the TPIPE, the OTMA client should be investigated to determine why an ACK or NAK response is not occurring or taking too long."}

situation_name: IMS_Online_Change_Active
description: Online change currently active
actions: {"The system has detected that an online change is currently active in the IMS system. This in itself is not a problem, however the status should eventually change to inactive once the online change has completed. If it does not, it is an indication that the online changes are not completing properly."}

situation_name: IMS_Online_Change_Occurred
description: Online change has occurred
actions: {"This is an indication that at least one online change has occurred during the running of this IMS system."}

situation_name: IMS_Parallel_DLI_Status
description: Parallel DLI inactive
actions: {"The Parallel DLI facility is inactive which will reduce the capability of the IMS system to run concurrent DLI requests. The configuration of the IMS system should be checked to insure that the facility is enabled."}

situation_name: IMS_Physical_Logger_SVC
description: Physical logger in SVC wait
actions: {"The task responsible for doing physical logging for IMS is currently in SVC wait. If this condition persists, then the logging activities for the IMS system will end up being delayed and cause the performance of the IMS applications to suffer."}

situation_name: IMS_Plex_Heartbeat
description: Heartbeat situation to detect IMS data sharing groups
actions: {"Heart beat situation: This situation should never be raised"}

situation_name: IMS_PoolFreeBlocks
description: Pool fragmentation
actions: {"The pool identified in this exception has exceeded the threshold for number of pool fragments. This can lead to excessive amounts of paging or to applications stalling because they cannot get a large enough pool area to handle the request. You can attempt to reduce the fragmentation by terminating tasks that may not be critical to your environment."}

situation_name: IMS_Pool_Util_High_Critical
description: Pool space utilization high
actions: {"The pool identified in this exception has exceeded the threshold for utilization. When pool space is exhausted, applications will stall while waiting for the pool space to become available again. You can address this issue by reducing the amount of work being requested or increasing the amount of storage available in the pool."}

situation_name: IMS_Pool_Util_High_Warning
description: Pool space utilization high
actions: {"The pool identified in this exception has exceeded the threshold for utilization. When pool space is exhausted, applications will stall while waiting for the pool space to become available again. You can address this issue by reducing the amount of work being requested or increasing the amount of storage available in the pool."}

situation_name: IMS_Private_PageIn_High_Critical
description: Private storage page in rate high
actions: {"The address space identified in the exception is causing high page in rates for private storage. This could be an indication of a problem with an application using too much private storage or possibly looping. If this condition persists, look at the job logs for the started task to determine if the region is abending."}

situation_name: IMS_Private_PageIn_High_Warning
description: Private storage page in rate high
actions: {"The address space identified in the exception is causing high page in rates for private storage. This could be an indication of a problem with an application using too much private storage or possibly looping. If this condition persists, look at the job logs for the started task to determine if the region is abending."}

situation_name: IMS_RTA_Group_Response_Critical
description: RTA Group response has exceeded the critical threshold.
actions: {"The R0 response time of an RTA group has exceeded 5 seconds or the R1 response time has exceeded 7 seconds. Action: Determine the reason for the bad response time (transaction waiting for a resource, bad design, ...)"}

situation_name: IMS_RTA_Group_Response_Warning
description: RTA Group response has exceeded the warning threshold.
actions: {"The R0 response time of an RTA group is between 3 and 5 seconds or the R1 response time is between 5 and 7 seconds. Action: No immediate action required. Watch the response time."}

situation_name: IMS_RTA_Item_Response_Critical
description: RTA Item response has exceeded the critical threshold.
actions: {"The R0 response time of an RTA item has exceeded 5 seconds or the R1 response time has exceeded 7 seconds. Action: Determine the reason for the bad response time (transaction waiting for a resource, bad design, ...)"}

situation_name: IMS_RTA_Item_Response_Warning
description: RTA Item response has exceeded the warning threshold.
actions: {"The R0 response time of an RTA item is between 3 and 5 seconds or the R1 response time is between 5 and 7 seconds. Action: No immediate action required. Watch the response time."}

situation_name: IMS_RTA_Threshold_Exceeded
description: RTA threshold exceeded
actions: {"Use Omegamon functions to determine the reason for the bad response time. Potential reasons: lock conflicts, problems with input or output queues, ..."}

situation_name: IMS_Recon_Reserved
description: RECON dataset reserved
actions: {"The RECON dataset is currently reserved by another application. This means that the dataset cannot be used by IMS until the reserve is released. Use the TSO LOCATE command to determine what other tasks may have the dataset reserved and take appropriate action to have them released."}

situation_name: IMS_Region_EXCP_High_Critical
description: Region I/O Rate High
actions: {"The address space identified in the exception is doing more I/O requests than the specified thresholds. The region may be in abend processing and generating a dump or attempting to recover from I/O errors on a database. If the problem persists, you should look at the JOB for the region to determine if it is currently running."}

situation_name: IMS_Region_EXCP_High_Warning
description: Region I/O Rate High
actions: {"The address space identified in the exception is doing more I/O requests than the specified thresholds. The region may be in abend processing and generating a dump or attempting to recover from I/O errors on a database. If the problem persists, you should look at the JOB for the region to determine if it is currently running."}

situation_name: IMS_Region_EXCP_Low_Critical
description: Region I/O Rate Low
actions: {"The address space identified in the exception is doing fewer I/O requests than the specified thresholds. This could be an indication that part or all of your IMS system has stalled. If the problem persists, you should look at the JOB for the region to determine if it is currently running."}

situation_name: IMS_Region_EXCP_Low_Warning
description: Region I/O Rate Low
actions: {"The address space identified in the exception is doing fewer I/O requests than the specified thresholds. This could be an indication that part or all of your IMS system has stalled. If the problem persists, you should look at the JOB for the region to determine if it is currently running."}

situation_name: IMS_Start_DC
description: Start DC not done
actions: {"The Start DC command was not issued for this system. If it is desired, issue the start now."}

situation_name: IMS_TCO_Inactive
description: Time control facility inactive
actions: {"The Time Control facilities within IMS are not active. If TCO is needed, you should reconfigure the system to make it available."}

situation_name: IMS_Tasks_Waiting_Critical
description: IMS Tasks waiting
actions: {"The number of IMS tasks that are waiting has exceeded the threshold. This is an indication that the system is not running as expected and analysis should be done to determine why the tasks are not active."}

situation_name: IMS_Tasks_Waiting_Warning
description: IMS Tasks waiting
actions: {"The number of IMS tasks that are waiting has exceeded the threshold. This is an indication that the system is not running as expected and analysis should be done to determine why the tasks are not active."}

situation_name: IMS_Threads_Active_High
description: IMS Threads Active High
actions: {"This situation triggers when the number of active CICS threads is greater than the threshold.Each CICS region that is connected to DBCTL has two parameters, MINTHRD and MAXTHRD, defined in its system generation to limit the number of threads that can be used for DBCTL database access. Each thread requires a DBCTL PST.For each CICS region, MINTHRD PSTs are always allocated and up to MAXTHRD PSTs can be allocated and made available for threads."}

situation_name: IMS_Threads_Active_Low
description: IMS Threads Active Low
actions: {"This situation triggers when the number of active CICS threads is less than the threshold.Each CICS region that is connected to DBCTL has two parameters, MINTHRD and MAXTHRD, defined in its system generation to limit the number of threads that can be used for DBCTL database access. Each thread requires a DBCTL PST.For each CICS region, MINTHRD PSTs are always allocated and up to MAXTHRD PSTs can be allocated and made available for threads."}

situation_name: IMS_Threads_Elapsed_Time_High
description: IMS Threads Elapsed Time High
actions: {"This situation triggers when the thread elapsed time exceeds the threshold. Identifying long running threads can detect and try to prevent application bottlenecks and response time problems. Long running threads can occur for various reasons such as database contention, IMS resource contention, or application programming/design errors. OMEGAMON XE for IMS provides thread detail, thread call stats, and lock contention information that can assist with determining the cause of a long running thread."}

situation_name: IMS_Tran_DLIDB_Calls_High
description: Transaction database calls high
actions: {"This situation triggers when the number of DL/I database calls for a transaction instance (UOR) exceeds the specified threshold.This can indicate that the transaction being processed is in a loop or that it is poorly designed.A high database call count can cause database buffer pools to fill and force other database records in the pools to be written to their database, which can cause IMS to perform excessive I/O."}

situation_name: IMS_Tran_ESAF_Calls_High
description: Transaction ESAF calls high
actions: {"This situation triggers when the number of external subsystem (ESAF) calls for a transaction instance (UOR) exceeds the specified threshold.This can indicate that the transaction being processed is in a loop or that it is poorly designed."}

situation_name: IMS_Tran_Elapsed_Time_High
description: Transaction elapsed time high
actions: {"This situation triggers when the elapsed time for a transaction instance (UOR) exceeds the specified threshold.This can indicate that the transaction being processed is in a loop, is poorly designed, or is possiblywaiting on a database lock."}

situation_name: IMS_Tran_OSAM_Reads_High
description: Transaction OSAM reads high
actions: {"This situation triggers when the OSAM read I/O count for a transaction instance (UOR) is greater than the specified threshold. This may be due to insufficient OSAM buffers of the appropriate size to adequately queue database segments."}

situation_name: IMS_Tran_Total_DBIO_High
description: Transaction total database IO high
actions: {"This situation triggers when the I/O count, VSAM and OSAM, for a transaction instance (UOR) is greater than the specified threshold.This may be due to insufficient buffers of the appropriate size to adequately queue database segments."}

situation_name: IMS_Tran_VSAM_Reads_High
description: Transaction VSAM reads high
actions: {"This situation triggers when the VSAM read I/O count for a transaction instance (UOR) is greater than the specified threshold. This may be due to insufficient VSAM buffers of the appropriate size to adequately queue database segments."}

situation_name: IMS_VSAM_Rate_High_Critical
description: VSAM dataset I/O rate high
actions: {"The VSAM dataset I/O rate has exceeded the threshold. When the rate for any database is high, it could cause the applications to slow down since they would end up sitting in an I/O wait status. The application should be checked to insure that it is running properly."}

situation_name: IMS_VSAM_Rate_High_Warning
description: VSAM dataset I/O rate high
actions: {"The VSAM dataset I/O rate has exceeded the threshold. When the rate for any database is high, it could cause the applications to slow down since they would end up sitting in an I/O wait status. The application should be checked to insure that it is running properly."}

situation_name: IMS_VTAM_ACB_Status
description: VTAM ACB closed
actions: {"The VTAM ACB currently has a status of Closed and cannot be used. This will cause connection problems for the physical terminals to IMS. Check the status of the VTAM started tasks to make sure they are running properly. You may need to contact operations to determine if there is a network problem in the data center."}

situation_name: IMS_VTAM_Auth_Path
description: VTAM Authorized path inactive
actions: {"The VTAM authorized path has a status of inactive. This limits the capability of VTAM to perform authorization, which could prevent users from accessing the IMS system. Verify that VTAM is properly defined."}

situation_name: IMS_WSS_High_Critical
description: Region working set high
actions: {"The address space identified in the exception has a larger working set size than the specified threshold. This could be an indication of a problem with an application not freeing up storage after it is used or possibly a looping condition. If this condition persists, look at the job logs for the started task to determine if the region is abending."}

situation_name: IMS_WSS_High_Warning
description: Region working set high
actions: {"The address space identified in the exception has a larger working set size than the specified threshold. This could be an indication of a problem with an application not freeing up storage after it is used or possibly a looping condition. If this condition persists, look at the job logs for the started task to determine if the region is abending."}

situation_name: IMS_WSS_Low_Critical
description: Region working set low
actions: {"The address space identified in the exception has a smaller working set size than the specified threshold. This could be an indication of a problem with an application or region being in a stalled state. If this condition persists, look at the job logs for the started task to determine if the region is still usable."}

situation_name: IMS_WSS_Low_Warning
description: Region working set low
actions: {"The address space identified in the exception has a smaller working set size than the specified threshold. This could be an indication of a problem with an application or region being in a stalled state. If this condition persists, look at the job logs for the started task to determine if the region is still usable."}
