actions: {"Set the warning threshold (in frames) for the available frame queue low alert. The available frame queue is a list of frames that are available to the system. If the number of frames is too low, SRM automatically replenishes the queue by stealing frames that have not been recently referenced.Controlling the available frame queue is the method SRM uses to manage storage use. A low available frame queue is a problem only if it causes a high page fault rate."}

situation_name: OS390_AvgCPU_Pct_Crit
description: Average CPU Utilization Critical Situation
actions: {"Average CPU Utilization exceeds the Critical threshold. This condition may or may not be a matter of immediate concern. If it arises suddenly on a uniprocessor, it may indicate that a unit of work is in a loop. If it is a chronic condition it could be that the system is kept busy with low priority work. If service classes are missing their goals, a change in goals or a capacity increase may be necessary."}

situation_name: OS390_AvgCPU_Pct_Warn
description: Average CPU Utilization Warning Situation
actions: {"Average CPU Utilization exceeds the Warning threshold. This condition may or may not be a matter of immediate concern. If it arises suddenly on a uniprocessor, it may indicate that a unit of work is in a loop. If it is a chronic condition it could be that the system is kept busy with low priority work. If service classes are missing their goals, a change in goals or a capacity increase may be necessary."}

situation_name: OS390_CSA_Growth_Crit
description: CSA Growth Critical Situation
actions: {"The growth in use of CSA (Common Services Area) storage exceeds its Critical threshold. If usage is already high, a system crash may occur due to exhausted CSA. In Current Situation Values identify the address spaces using high amounts of CSA and showing rapid growth in its use. Nonessential address spaces with high growth rates should be stopped or canceled to prevent a crash."}

situation_name: OS390_CSA_Growth_Warn
description: CSA Growth Warning Situation
actions: {"The growth in use of CSA (Common Services Area) storage exceeds its Warning threshold. If usage is already high, a system crash may occur due to exhausted CSA. In Current Situation Values identify the address spaces using high amounts of CSA and showing rapid growth in its use. Nonessential address spaces with high growth rates should be stopped or canceled to prevent a crash."}

situation_name: OS390_Cache_FastWriteHitPt_Crit
description: DASD Cache Fast Write Hit Critical Situation
actions: {"The DASD Fast Write hit ratio is less than the Critical percentage. This may or may not represent a problem. If no service class is missing goals based on I/O delay, the threshold may have to be adjusted. If service class periods are missing goals based on delay from the indicated device, data sets may have to be moved so that the Fast Write Cache capacity will be better matched to the workload."}

situation_name: OS390_Cache_FastWriteHitPt_Warn
description: DASD Cache Fast Write Hit Warning Situation
actions: {"The DASD Fast Write hit ratio is less than the Warning percentage. This may or may not represent a problem. If no service class is missing goals based on I/O delay, the threshold may have to be adjusted. If service class periods are missing goals based on delay from the indicated device, data sets may have to be moved so that the Fast Write Cache capacity will be better matched to the workload."}

situation_name: OS390_Cache_Read_HitPct_Crit
description: DASD Cache Read Hit Critical Situation
actions: {"The Cache read hit ratio for the indicated device is less than the Critical threshold. If so, a performance specialist should do further research to see if I/O tuning (data set placement) is necessary.If no goals are being missed the threshold might have to be adjusted."}

situation_name: OS390_Cache_Read_HitPct_Warn
description: DASD Cache Read Hit Warning Situation
actions: {"The Cache read hit ratio for the indicated device is less than the Warningthreshold. If so, a performance specialist should do further research to see if I/O tuning (data set placement) is necessary.If no goals are being missed the threshold might have to be adjusted."}

situation_name: OS390_Cache_Write_HitPct_Crit
description: DASD Cache Write Hit Critical Situation
actions: {"The Cache write hit ratio for the indicated device is less than the Critical threshold. Check to see if any address spaces that have this device number allocated are in service classes that are missing their goals. If so, a performance specialist should do further research to see if I/O tuning (data set placement) is necessary. If no goals are being missed the threshold might have to be adjusted."}

situation_name: OS390_Cache_Write_HitPct_Warn
description: DASD Cache Write Hit Warning Situation
actions: {"The Cache write hit ratio for the indicated device is less than the Warning threshold. Check to see if any address spaces that have this device number allocated are in service classes that are missing their goals. If so, a performance specialist should do further research to see if I/O tuning (data set placement) is necessary. If no goals are being missed the threshold might have to be adjusted."}

situation_name: OS390_ChannelComplexBusy_Crit
description: Channel paths complex percent busy critical situation
actions: {"One or more channel paths is busier on all systems than the current Critical threshold. Check Current Situation Values to identify the particular channel(s) that are unusually active. Note that the acceptable busy levels for tape channels, ESCON channels, and FICON channels are much higher than typical rules of thumb for parallel DASD channels. If the threshold is too low, adjust it using the Situation Editor."}

situation_name: OS390_ChannelComplexBusy_Warn
description: Channel paths complex percent busy warning situation
actions: {"One or more channel paths is busier on all systems than the current Warning threshold. Check Current Situation Values to identify the particular channel(s) that are unusually active. Note that the acceptable busy levels for tape channels, ESCON channels, and FICON channels are much higher than typical rules of thumb for parallel DASD channels. If the threshold is too low, adjust it using the Situation Editor."}

situation_name: OS390_Channel_LPAR_BusyPct_Crit
description: Channel paths LPAR percent busy critical situation
actions: {"One or more channel paths is busier on this LPAR than the current Critical threshold. Check Current Situation Values to identify the particular channel(s) that are unusually active. Note that the acceptable busy levels for tape channels, ESCON channels, and FICON channels are much higher than typical rules of thumb for parallel DASD channels. If the threshold is too low, adjust it using the Situation Editor."}

situation_name: OS390_Channel_LPAR_BusyPct_Warn
description: Channel paths LPAR percent busy warning situation
actions: {"One or more channel paths is busier on this LPAR than the current Warning threshold. Check Current Situation Values to identify the particular channel(s) that are unusually active. Note that the acceptable busy levels for tape channels, ESCON channels, and FICON channels are much higher than typical rules of thumb for parallel DASD channels. If the threshold is too low, adjust it using the Situation Editor."}

situation_name: OS390_Channel_Path_Offline_Crit
description: Channel Path Offline Critical Situation
actions: {"A channel path is offline. This may be a normal condition if the indicated channel path is dynamically managed. Check the configuration matrix for the current image and determine if this channel path should be online. If it should be, attempt to vary it online."}

situation_name: OS390_Channel_Path_Offline_Warn
description: Channel Path Offline Warning Situation
actions: {"A channel path is offline. This may be a normal condition if the indicated channel path is dynamically managed. Check the configuration matrix for the current image and determine if this channel path should be online. If it should be, attempt to vary it online."}

situation_name: OS390_Common_PageDSPctFull_Crit
description: Common Page Dataset Percent Full Critical Situation
actions: {"The percentage of slots in use on the common page data set exceeds the current Critical threshold. If the common page data set becomes full, a system crash is imminent. A system programmer should immediately determine which address spaces are using the largest number of common slots, and terminate those which can be shut down at this time. If this situation occurs more frequently than once a month, a larger common page data set should be created and activated at the next IPL (with CLPA)."}

situation_name: OS390_Common_PageDSPctFull_Warn
description: Common Page Dataset Percent Full Warning Situation
actions: {"The percentage of slots in use on the common page data set exceeds the current Warning threshold. If this situation occurs more frequently than once a day, common page data set utilization should be tracked carefully to determine if there is a growth trend. Possible responses might include adjustment of the threshold, replacement of the data set with a larger one, and service research to determine if there is a known source of CSA growth."}

situation_name: OS390_DASD_Busy_Percent_Crit
description: DASD device percent busy critical situation
actions: {"The indicated DASD device utilization exceeds the current Critical threshold. This condition may represent a current or pending performance problem if any service class period is missing its goal because of I/O delay for this device. This threshold is 100% by default and should be set to a lower value only when pursuing a chronic DASD performance problem."}

situation_name: OS390_DASD_Busy_Percent_Warn
description: DASD device percent busy warning situation
actions: {"The indicated DASD device utilization exceeds the current Warning threshold. This condition may represent a current or pending performance problem if any service class period is missing its goal because of I/O delay for this device. This threshold is 100% by default and should be set to a lower value only when pursuing a chronic DASD performance problem."}

situation_name: OS390_DASD_Dropped_Ready_Crit
description: DASD Dropped Ready Critical Situation
actions: {"The number of DASD devices that have dropped ready exceeds the Critical threshold. On the rare occassion this happens a hardware service person should be called."}

situation_name: OS390_DASD_Dropped_Ready_Warn
description: DASD Dropped Ready Warning Situation
actions: {"The number of DASD devices that have dropped ready exceeds the Warning threshold. On the rare occassion this happens a hardware service person should be called."}

situation_name: OS390_DASD_NoDynamicReconn_Crit
description: DASD No Dynamic Path Reconnect Critical Situation
actions: {"The number of DASD devices experiencing Dynamic Path Reconnect failure exceeds the current Critical threshold. This problem should be referred to a hardware customer engineer and to a storage management specialist to determine if the devices should be offloaded."}

situation_name: OS390_DASD_NoDynamicReconn_Warn
description: DASD No Dynamic Path Reconnect Warning Situation
actions: {"The number of DASD devices experiencing Dynamic Path Reconnect failure exceeds the current Warning threshold. This problem should be referred to a hardware customer engineer and to a storage management specialist to determine if the devices should be offloaded."}

situation_name: OS390_DASD_Not_Responding_Crit
description: DASD Not Responding Critical Situation
actions: {"The number of DASD devices that are not responding exceeds the Critical threshold. On the rare occassion this happens, a hardware service person should be called."}

situation_name: OS390_DASD_Not_Responding_Warn
description: DASD Not Responding Warning Situation
actions: {"The number of DASD devices that are not responding exceeds the Warning threshold. On the rare occassion this happens, a hardware service person should be called."}

situation_name: OS390_DASD_Response_Time_Crit
description: DASD device response time critical situation
actions: {"The response time for a DASD device exceeds the current Critical threshold. This situation is disabled by default and should be activated only when attempting to solve a problem where excessive DASD response time is likely to be a cause."}

situation_name: OS390_DASD_Response_Time_Warn
description: DASD device response time warning situation
actions: {"The response time for a DASD device exceeds the current Warning threshold. This situation is disabled by default and should be activated only when attempting to solve a problem where excessive DASD response time is likely to be a cause."}

situation_name: OS390_ECSA_Allocation_Pct_Crit
description: Extended CSA Allocation % Critical Situation
actions: {"Extended CSA allocation exceeds the current Critical threshold. Check the current size of ECSA (the second CSA subparameter in IEASYSxx). Notify a system programmer. If this condition arises more than once a week the value may have to be adjusted before the next IPL. Use the Current Situation Values to determine who is using excessive ECSA or causing it to grow rapidly."}

situation_name: OS390_ECSA_Allocation_Pct_Warn
description: Extended CSA Allocation % Warning Situation
actions: {"Extended CSA allocation exceeds the current Warning threshold. Check the current size of ECSA (the second CSA subparameter in IEASYSxx). Notify a system programmer. If this condition arises more than once a week the value may have to be adjusted before the next IPL. Use the Current Situation Values to determine who is using excessive ECSA or causing it to grow rapidly."}

situation_name: OS390_Frames_Online_Crit
description: Central storage online frame count critical situation
actions: {"Set the critical threshold for storage that should be online. The value must be less than the warning threshold.To be alerted of any loss of storage, you may want to set the threshold to the amount of storage that should always be online."}

situation_name: OS390_Frames_Online_Warn
description: Central storage online frame count warning situation
actions: {"Set the warning threshold (in frames) for online storage. The value must be greater than the critical threshold.You may want to leave this threshold off, and use the critical threshold to alert you of any storage loss."}

situation_name: OS390_GRS_Broken_Crit
description: GRS Broken Critical Situation
actions: {"This alert displays if the global resource serialization (GRS)complex is broken.If the GRS complex is broken, it may be necessary to go to the console, and then attempt to restart GRS (see Vary GRS in the z/OS commands).Display the status of the channel-to-channel adapters, or the connections to the coupling facility if using GRS star, on each system by entering D GRS."}

situation_name: OS390_GRS_Broken_Warn
description: GRS Broken Warning Situation
actions: {"This alert displays if the global resource serialization (GRS)complex is broken.If the GRS complex is broken, it may be necessary to go to the console, and then attempt to restart GRS (see Vary GRS in the z/OS commands).Display the status of the channel-to-channel adapters, or the connections to the coupling facility if using GRS star, on each system by entering D GRS."}

situation_name: OS390_GTF_Active_Crit
description: GTF Active Critical Situation
actions: {"GTF (Generalized Trace Facility) is a useful diagnostic tool but can cause performance degradation. Determine who is using GTF and make sure it will be active for the minimum time necessary to get the needed data."}

situation_name: OS390_GTF_Active_Warn
description: GTF Active Warning Situation
actions: {"GTF (Generalized Trace Facility) is a useful diagnostic tool but can cause performance degradation. Determine who is using GTF and make sure it will be active for the minimum time necessary to get the needed data."}

situation_name: OS390_GlobalEnqueueReserve_Crit
description: System Global Enqueue and Reserve Critical
actions: {"ENQueue delay is high and has remained so for over a minute.Check the details to determine who is holding the ENQ.If it is a batch job that can be canceled and requeued, the deadlock can be broken by doing so.If it is a started task or on-line user, a system programmer should be called."}

situation_name: OS390_GlobalEnqueueReserve_Warn
description: System Global Enqueue and Reserve Warning
actions: {"ENQueue delay is high.Check the details to determine who is holding the ENQ.If it is a batch job that can be canceled and requeued, the deadlock can be broken by doing so.If it is a started task or on-line user, a system programmer should be called."}

situation_name: OS390_HSM_RecallWait_Crit
description: HSM Recall Wait Time Critical Situation
actions: {"A wait for an HSM data set recall exceeds the Critical threshold.Make sure that there is not an outstanding tape mount for an HSM tape. In some cases the wait can occur when a Migration Level 1 volume is tied up by a RESERVE or other conflicting activity such as a volume backup."}

situation_name: OS390_HSM_RecallWait_Warn
description: HSM Recall Wait Time Warning Situation
actions: {"A wait for an HSM data set recall exceeds the Warning threshold.Make sure that there is not an outstanding tape mount for an HSM tape. In some cases the wait can occur when a Migration Level 1 volume is tied up by a RESERVE or other conflicting activity such as a volume backup."}

situation_name: OS390_Indexed_VTOC_Lost_Crit
description: Indexed VTOC Lost Critical Situation
actions: {"The number of devices on which Indexed VTOC function has been lost exceeds the current Critical threshold. On heavily used volumes with many datasets, an index to a VTOC may significantly improve I/O performance.System routines at times may disable a VTOC index, returning it to non-indexed format.Use the DSF BUILDIX command (see the IBM \"Device Support Facilities Users Guide and Reference\") to return to indexed format.If the problem persists, you may need to delete and rebuild the index using DSF."}

situation_name: OS390_Indexed_VTOC_Lost_Warn
description: Indexed VTOC Lost Warning Situation
actions: {"The number of devices on which Indexed VTOC function has been lost exceeds the current Warning threshold. On heavily used volumes with many datasets, an index to a VTOC may significantly improve I/O performance.System routines at times may disable a VTOC index, returning it to non-indexed format.Use the DSF BUILDIX command (see the IBM \"Device Support Facilities Users Guide and Reference\") to return to indexed format.If the problem persists, you may need to delete and rebuild the index using DSF."}

situation_name: OS390_LPAR_OverheadPercent_Crit
description: LPAR Overhead Percent Critical Situation
actions: {"LPAR (PR/SM) overhead exceeds the current Critical threshold. Possible causes include saturation of the CPU capacity leading to excessive overhead switching CPUs between LPARs. This can be compounded when there are too many logical processors assigned to an LPAR. IF the PR/SM overhead is confined to one LPAR, consider reducing the number of logical processors in that LPAR."}

situation_name: OS390_LPAR_OverheadPercent_Warn
description: LPAR Overhead Percent Warning Situation
actions: {"LPAR (PR/SM) overhead exceeds the current Warning threshold. Possible causes include saturation of the CPU capacity leading to excessive overhead switching CPUs between LPARs. This can be compounded when there are too many logical processors assigned to an LPAR. IF the PR/SM overhead is confined to one LPAR, consider reducing the number of logical processors in that LPAR."}

situation_name: OS390_LPAR_Status_Crit
description: LPAR Status Indicators Critical Situation
actions: {"LPAR CPU Management Overhead or, Effective Weight Index have exceeded thresholds. These conditions may or may not be of immediate concern. In the case of LPAR CPU Management Overhead, if the number of configured LPARs is substantial, this condition may arise. If the condition is chronic, you may consider reducing the number of configured LPARs. In the case of Effective Weight Index, you may want to adjust the LPAR Weight if the LPAR's workload are not meeting expected service levels."}
